# Introduction

Run the Tempest plugins on your Hytale server, and build on them.

The Tempest plugins can be used from other plugins (Java) and from content mods that have no code (JSON assets). **Core** is the base: everything shared is in `com.atomictempest.core`
(events, leaderboards, help, settings, HUD lines, perks, and the economy bridge). Each plugin has its own small `api`
package.

| Plugin | Manifest id | API |
|---|---|---|
| Core | `AtomicTempest:Core` | `com.atomictempest.core` (`economy.Economies`, events, leaderboards, help, settings, HUD lines, perks) |
| Coins | `AtomicTempest:Coins` | `com.atomictempest.coins.api.CoinsAPI` (what only Coins has), `CoinStacks` |
| Quests | `AtomicTempest:Quests` | `com.atomictempest.quests.api.QuestsAPI` |
| Lottery | `AtomicTempest:Lottery` | `com.atomictempest.lottery.api.LotteryAPI` |
| SlotMachine | `AtomicTempest:SlotMachine` | `com.atomictempest.slotmachine.api.SlotMachineAPI` |
| Shop | `AtomicTempest:Shop` | `com.atomictempest.shop.api.ShopAPI` |
| Coinflip | `AtomicTempest:Coinflip` | `com.atomictempest.coinflip.api.CoinflipAPI`, `RoomMode` |
| Events | `AtomicTempest:Events` | no API of its own: it turns on Core's `Boosts` (below) and has placeholders |
| Contracts | `AtomicTempest:Contracts` | no API of its own: the `contract_deliver` action, the `contract_pay` boost kind and placeholders |
| Projects | `AtomicTempest:Projects` | `com.atomictempest.projects.api.ProjectsAPI` (the buildings and their states); the `projects_donate` action (amount: items given), `projects_coins` (amount: coins given) and the `projects_open` placeholder |
| Town | `AtomicTempest:Town` | no API of its own: it decides Core's `Unlocks` (below), and has the `town_unlocked`, `town_total` and `town_mayor` placeholders |
| Crates | `AtomicTempest:Crates` | no API of its own: the `crate_open` action and `Announcements.BIG_WIN` |
| Holograms | `AtomicTempest:Holograms` | `com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Holograms` (and `Hologram`, `TextArt`, `Rankings`...) |
| Pass | `AtomicTempest:Pass` | `com.atomictempest.pass.api.PassAPI` |
| Jobs | `AtomicTempest:Jobs` | `com.atomictempest.jobs.api.JobsAPI` |
| Trade | `AtomicTempest:Trade` | no API of its own: the `trade_done` action |

With **Endless Leveling** or **MMO Skill Tree** installed, Core's `Levels` and `Skills` give every plugin player
levels, skills and what happens in them, without depending on either mod.

Every API class has a version constant that goes up when something is added. Everything in these APIs is safe to call
from any thread unless it says otherwise.

**Javadoc:** [Coinflip 1.0.4](javadoc/coinflip/) · [Coins 2.4.1](javadoc/coins/) · [Core 1.6.0](javadoc/core/) · [Holograms 1.2.2](javadoc/holograms/) · [Jobs 1.1.1](javadoc/jobs/) · [Lottery 1.1.3](javadoc/lottery/) · [Pass 1.3.0](javadoc/pass/) · [Projects 1.1.1](javadoc/projects/) · [Quests 1.5.0](javadoc/quests/) · [Shop 1.5.1](javadoc/shop/) · [SlotMachine 1.2.3](javadoc/slotmachine/)

**Jars:** from the plugins' CurseForge pages; compile against them with `compileOnly`. **Questions and help:** [Discord](https://discord.gg/Q9PNVCMZXK)


# Server guide

How the Tempest plugins work in game, for server owners and admins: commands, permissions, every setting and what players see.

The pages in this section are made from the plugins themselves: the commands, the `/tempest` settings with their
explanations, and the `/guide` pages players read. They say exactly what the game says.

## Install

1. Put **Tempest Core** in your server's `mods` folder. Every other Tempest plugin needs it.
2. Put the plugins you want next to it. Each one works on its own; together they connect (quests count crates,
   events boost the shop, jobs pay more for what contracts want, and so on).
3. Money comes from **Tempest Economy (Coins)**, or from any economy plugin through VaultUnlocked.
4. Start the server. Each plugin makes its files under `universe/mods` with safe defaults.

## Two commands to know

| Command | Who | What it opens |
|---|---|---|
| `/tempest` | Admins | Every setting of every Tempest plugin, one tab each, with a search box. Changes are saved at once |
| `/guide` | Everyone | The help pages: what each plugin does and how to start |
| `/tempest doctor` | Admins | Checks every plugin's settings for money made from nothing (a shop that buys for more than it sells, a quest that pays more than it costs) |

## Permissions

| Permission | Gives |
|---|---|
| `tempest.admin` | Every `/tempest` tab |
| `tempest.admin.<group>` | One plugin's tabs only, e.g. `tempest.admin.jobs` or `tempest.admin.crates` |
| A plugin's admin permission (`jobs.admin`, `crates.admin`, `holograms.admin`...) | That plugin's admin commands and editors |

Commands that run as the server console (reward commands in quests, the pass, events, jobs and projects) can be set
only by players with `tempest.admin`, whatever else they have. Every command and the permission it needs:
[All commands and permissions](guide-commands.html).

## Free and Pro

Some plugins come as a free jar and a Pro jar with the same name. The Pro jar replaces the free one and keeps
everything the server made. Free limits only stop you making more: they never break what a server already has.
Core, Economy and the plugins' APIs are always free.

## Languages

Every text players see is in 8 languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and
Russian). Players get their game's language when Tempest has it; the server-wide language is in `/tempest` → General.
With a Pro plugin installed, `/tempest texts` lets you reword any text.


# All commands and permissions

Every command of every Tempest plugin, and who can use it.

Every command of the Tempest plugins, with the permission it needs. "Everyone" works for every player; a permission means only players or groups given it.

## Core

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/board` (/sidebar) | Everyone | Pick what your board on the right of the screen shows, or hide it |
| `/booster` | `tempest.boosters` | Give a player a booster for a while (admins, crate and vote rewards) |
| `/guide` (/serverhelp) | Everyone | How the server's shop, crates, quests and money work |
| `/hud` (/coinhud) | Everyone | Show or hide your money counter (/hud top, left or low moves it) |
| `/hud left` | Everyone | Money counter in the top left corner |
| `/hud low` | Everyone | Money counter on the right side, lower down |
| `/hud top` | Everyone | Money counter in a row along the top, right of centre |
| `/mail` (/mailbox) | Everyone | Open your mailbox: rewards and items kept for you |
| `/places` | Everyone | Places on the world map, and what your map shows |
| `/places add` | `tempest.admin.map` | Adds a place to the map where you stand (admins) |
| `/serverinfo` (/rules, /info) | Everyone | The server's rules and info |
| `/tempest` (/casino) | Everyone | Tempest: the settings menu for admins, the help screen for players |
| `/tempest doctor` | `tempest.admin` | Finds ways players could make money from nothing in the settings (admins) |
| `/tempest info` | `tempest.admin` | Tempest plugins: versions, editions and the economy (admins) |
| `/tempest log` | `tempest.admin` | Who changed what: the newest lines of the admin log (admins) |
| `/tempest report` | `tempest.admin` | Writes a support report to paste when asking for help (admins) |
| `/tempest settings` | Everyone | Open the Tempest settings menu (admins) |
| `/tempest texts` | Everyone | Change any text players see (admins) |

## Economy (Coins)

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/atm` | `coins.admin.atm` | Admin: get an ATM in a design to place |
| `/baltop` (/rich) | Everyone | Show the richest players |
| `/bank` (/banks) | Everyone | Your shared bank accounts |
| `/bank open` | Everyone | Open one bank by name |
| `/coins` (/coinhelp) | Everyone | Help for coins, the wallet, banks and daily rewards |
| `/daily` | Everyone | Open the daily reward calendar |
| `/economy` (/eco) | `coins.admin.economy` | Admin: the economy screen, and changing balances |
| `/economy add` | `coins.admin.economy` | Give a player money |
| `/economy import` | `coins.admin.economy` | Copy every player's balance from another economy (Ecotale, or one through VaultUnlocked) |
| `/economy set` | `coins.admin.economy` | Set a player's balance to an amount |
| `/economy take` | `coins.admin.economy` | Take money from a player |
| `/leaderboards` (/leaderboard, /ranks) | Everyone | The richest players, biggest winners and best traders |
| `/pay` | Everyone | Send money from your wallet to another player |
| `/wallet` (/balance, /bal) | Everyone | Open your wallet: balance, coins, payments and history |

## Shop

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/sell` | Everyone | Sell items to the shop |
| `/sell all` | Everyone | Sell every item the shop buys |
| `/sell hand` | Everyone | Sell the item in your hand |
| `/shop` | Everyone | Open the shop |
| `/shop link` | `shop.admin` | Make the block you look at a shop, selling as this stall kind |
| `/shop stall` | `shop.admin` | Get a stall to place |
| `/shop unlink` | `shop.admin` | Make the block you look at an ordinary block again |

## Crates

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/cratekey` | `crates.admin` | Give a player crate keys |
| `/crates` (/crate) | Everyone | Open crates for prizes |
| `/crates log` | `crates.admin` | Admins: a player's newest crate openings, for prize questions |
| `/keyparty` | `crates.admin` | Give everyone online crate keys after a countdown (Pro) |

## Quests

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/achievements` (/achievement, /ach) | Everyone | Your achievements and how close you are |
| `/quests` (/quest) | Everyone | Your quests and the quest board |
| `/questtrigger` | `quests.admin` | Count a custom quest trigger for a player |

## Battle pass

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/pass` (/battlepass) | Everyone | Open the battle pass: tiers, rewards and your XP |
| `/pass premium` | `pass.admin` | Give a player the premium track for this season (admins) |
| `/pass xp` | `pass.admin` | Give a player pass XP, or take it with a negative amount (admins) |

## Events

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/events` (/event) | Everyone | Server events: what is on, what is coming, and the community goal |
| `/events extend` | `events.admin` | More or fewer minutes for the event that is on (admins) |
| `/events give` (/fund) | Everyone | Put money in the server fund: when it is full, an event starts for everyone |
| `/events list` | `events.admin` | Every event and the next starts (admins) |
| `/events start` | `events.admin` | Start an event now (admins) |
| `/events stop` | `events.admin` | Stop the event that is on (admins) |

## Contracts and bounties

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/contracts` (/contract) | Everyone | Open the contracts board: deliver items for money, or ask for the items you need |
| `/contracts bounties` (/bounty) | Everyone | Bounties: put money on a player, or hunt one down |
| `/contracts list` | `contracts.admin` | Admins: the board in chat |
| `/contracts mine` | Everyone | Your contracts: collect what was delivered |
| `/contracts post` | Everyone | Post a contract: ask for items and pay for them |

## Town projects

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/projects` (/project) | Everyone | See the town projects and donate to them |
| `/projects cancel` | `projects.admin` | Cancel a project: everything goes back |
| `/projects coins` | `projects.admin` | Set the coin goal of a project |
| `/projects finish` | `projects.admin` | Finish a project now: the whole building goes up |
| `/projects list` | `projects.admin` | List every project |
| `/projects material` | `projects.admin` | Change a material of a project (0 takes it off) |
| `/projects new` | `projects.admin` | Pick a prefab and place a new project |
| `/projects out` | Everyone | Leave a plot under construction |
| `/projects pause` | `projects.admin` | Pause a project |
| `/projects place` | `projects.admin` | Go back to the plot you are placing |
| `/projects plan` | `projects.admin` | Mark a plot for a prefab where you stand |
| `/projects prefabs` | `projects.admin` | Find prefabs by name |
| `/projects remove` | `projects.admin` | Take an ended project off the list |
| `/projects resume` | `projects.admin` | Go on with a paused project |
| `/projects reward` | `projects.admin` | Add a console command run for each donor at the end |
| `/projects rewarditems` | `projects.admin` | Pro: items every donor gets at the end (none clears them) |
| `/projects start` | `projects.admin` | Start the project on the marked plot |
| `/projects stop` | `projects.admin` | Stop a project: what stands stays |

# Core

The base: /tempest, /guide, the board, the mailbox, rank perks, the map, boosters.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Money counter

- The number in the corner of your screen is your balance in copper. When it changes, the gain or loss flashes beside it in green or red.
- Next to it you may see short notes: a daily reward waiting, the slot machine jackpot, the lottery pot, a quest you are tracking, or what the shop pays for the item in your hand.

**Your counter**

- It is shown, in the "top" position.
- /hud hides or shows it. /hud top, /hud left and /hud low move it.

|---|---|---|
| `/board` (/sidebar) | Everyone | Pick what your board on the right of the screen shows, or hide it |

## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### General

`/tempest` → General. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

#### Money

Prices and rewards in every AtomicTempest plugin use the server's economy: Coins when it is installed, otherwise any economy plugin that works with VaultUnlocked.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Show the money counter | Players can still hide theirs with /hud. | On or off |
| Starting corner | Players can move theirs with /hud. | Top right, Left, Lower right |
| Short amounts on the counter | Big balances in short, such as 12.5K and 3.2M, so they fit. | On or off |

#### Tempest board

A panel on the right of each player's screen with their name, world and money, the server, and a live line from every Tempest plugin (daily reward, lottery pot, jackpot, tracked quest, pass tier). Each player picks what theirs shows, or hides it, with /board.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Show the board | The plugins' lines move from the money counter to the board. | On or off |
| Where it starts | Players move theirs in /board. Pick a free side if another plugin has a panel there. | Right, top, Right, middle, Left, top, Left, middle |
| Size | Players pick their own in /board. | Normal, Small |
| Hide the money counter with the board | While a player's board shows their money, the counter at the top goes away. | On or off |
| Board title | Your server's name, in the menu theme's colour. Empty: no title. | Text |
| Line under the title | Such as your server's address or Discord. Empty: none. | Text |
| Players may show the time | The time of day in their world. | On or off |
| Players may show their ping | Lets each player add their ping (the delay between them and the server) to their own Tempest board. Players switch it on themselves in /board. | On or off |
| Players may show their position | Off for servers where coordinates should stay secret. Players switch it on themselves. | On or off |
| Your own line 1 | "Label \| text": placeholders show other plugins' numbers, such as "Kills \| {myplugin_kills}". Without \| it is one line of text. | Text |
| Your own line 2 | Empty: none. | Text |
| Your own line 3 | Empty: none. | Text |
| Your own line 4 | Empty: none. | Text |
| Your own line 5 | Empty: none. | Text |

#### Menus

The look of every Tempest menu, for every player.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Menu theme | Tempest gold is the plugins' own look. | Tempest gold, Dark crimson, Elven emerald, Frostbite, Amethyst, Cyberpunk neon, Cozy parchment, Your own colours |
| Your own: highlights | With "Your own colours": titles and the chosen tab. | A colour |
| Your own: background | With "Your own colours": laid over each menu. | A colour |

#### New players

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Help screen for new players | Opens /guide the first time someone joins. | On or off |
| What's on, when players join | A few chat lines from the Tempest board: a daily reward waiting, a running event, the lottery pot. Nothing when there is nothing to say. | On or off |
| Tips for players | One line about something the server has, taken from /guide. Each tip comes once per player, then they stop. | On or off |
| Minutes between tips | How long one player waits between two tips. Each tip comes only once per player, so after a while the tips stop by themselves. | 1 to 1440 |

#### Updates

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tell admins about new versions | Once a day the server reads which Tempest versions are out (a small file on our site; nothing about your server is sent). Admins get one line when they join. | On or off |

#### Language

Players see these plugins in the language their game is set to. Hytale does not offer German, Italian or Polish yet: pick one language here and every player gets the plugins in it.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Language | Or the language of each player's game. | Each player's own, English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Polski, Português (Brasil), Русский |

#### Games of chance

Slots, Lottery and Coinflip use only money earned in game. A daily limit stops anyone from losing too much in a day; it starts again at midnight.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Daily limit for games | Per player, all games together. 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000 |


### Rank Perks

`/tempest` → Rank Perks. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

#### Rank perks

Give a rank a perk's permission in your ranks plugin (LuckPerms, or Hytale's own permissions) and its players get the bonuses. Leave the permission empty to switch a perk off.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Perk 1 | Name | Text |
| Permission | The permission that gives this perk, such as tempest.perk.vip. Give it to a rank in your ranks plugin (LuckPerms or Hytale's own permissions). Empty: this perk is off. A player with several perks gets the best of each bonus. | Text |
| Daily rewards | Bonus (%) | 0 to 1000 |
| Quest rewards (%) | Players with this perk get this much more money from quest and achievement rewards. | 0 to 1000 |
| Shop | Discount (%) | 0 to 90 |
| Sell bonus (%) | Players with this perk get this much more when they sell to the shop. A sale never pays more than the item costs to buy, so it cannot be turned into a money loop. | 0 to 1000 |
| Payment fee cut (%) | 100 = this rank pays no fee when paying other players. | 0 to 100 |
| Pass XP (%) | Tempest Pass, Pro edition: more pass XP for this rank. | 0 to 1000 |
| Leveling XP (%) | More XP in the leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree) for this rank. Adds to the Leveling XP boost, with events and boosters, up to the highest boost set on the Leveling tab. Does nothing without a leveling mod. | 0 to 1000 |
| Perk 2 | Name | Text |
| Permission | The permission that gives this perk, such as tempest.perk.vip. Give it to a rank in your ranks plugin (LuckPerms or Hytale's own permissions). Empty: this perk is off. A player with several perks gets the best of each bonus. | Text |
| Daily rewards | Bonus (%) | 0 to 1000 |
| Quest rewards (%) | Players with this perk get this much more money from quest and achievement rewards. | 0 to 1000 |
| Shop | Discount (%) | 0 to 90 |
| Sell bonus (%) | Players with this perk get this much more when they sell to the shop. A sale never pays more than the item costs to buy, so it cannot be turned into a money loop. | 0 to 1000 |
| Payment fee cut (%) | 100 = this rank pays no fee when paying other players. | 0 to 100 |
| Pass XP (%) | Tempest Pass, Pro edition: more pass XP for this rank. | 0 to 1000 |
| Leveling XP (%) | More XP in the leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree) for this rank. Adds to the Leveling XP boost, with events and boosters, up to the highest boost set on the Leveling tab. Does nothing without a leveling mod. | 0 to 1000 |
| Perk 3 | Name | Text |
| Permission | The permission that gives this perk, such as tempest.perk.vip. Give it to a rank in your ranks plugin (LuckPerms or Hytale's own permissions). Empty: this perk is off. A player with several perks gets the best of each bonus. | Text |
| Daily rewards | Bonus (%) | 0 to 1000 |
| Quest rewards (%) | Players with this perk get this much more money from quest and achievement rewards. | 0 to 1000 |
| Shop | Discount (%) | 0 to 90 |
| Sell bonus (%) | Players with this perk get this much more when they sell to the shop. A sale never pays more than the item costs to buy, so it cannot be turned into a money loop. | 0 to 1000 |
| Payment fee cut (%) | 100 = this rank pays no fee when paying other players. | 0 to 100 |
| Pass XP (%) | Tempest Pass, Pro edition: more pass XP for this rank. | 0 to 1000 |
| Leveling XP (%) | More XP in the leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree) for this rank. Adds to the Leveling XP boost, with events and boosters, up to the highest boost set on the Leveling tab. Does nothing without a leveling mod. | 0 to 1000 |
| Perk 4 | Name | Text |
| Permission | The permission that gives this perk, such as tempest.perk.vip. Give it to a rank in your ranks plugin (LuckPerms or Hytale's own permissions). Empty: this perk is off. A player with several perks gets the best of each bonus. | Text |
| Daily rewards | Bonus (%) | 0 to 1000 |
| Quest rewards (%) | Players with this perk get this much more money from quest and achievement rewards. | 0 to 1000 |
| Shop | Discount (%) | 0 to 90 |
| Sell bonus (%) | Players with this perk get this much more when they sell to the shop. A sale never pays more than the item costs to buy, so it cannot be turned into a money loop. | 0 to 1000 |
| Payment fee cut (%) | 100 = this rank pays no fee when paying other players. | 0 to 100 |
| Pass XP (%) | Tempest Pass, Pro edition: more pass XP for this rank. | 0 to 1000 |
| Leveling XP (%) | More XP in the leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree) for this rank. Adds to the Leveling XP boost, with events and boosters, up to the highest boost set on the Leveling tab. Does nothing without a leveling mod. | 0 to 1000 |


### Server info

`/tempest` → Server info. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

Your own page: rules and anything players should know. It is the first page of /guide (new players see it on their first join when that is on) and /info or /rules opens it.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Show the page | On: /info and /rules open this page, and it is the first page of /guide (new players see it when they first join, if that is on). Off: the page is hidden. | On or off |
| Title | The heading at the top of the page, such as your server's name or "Rules". | Text |
| Line 1 | Start a line with # to make it a heading; an empty line is a gap. One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 2 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 3 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 4 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 5 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 6 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 7 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 8 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 9 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 10 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 11 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |
| Line 12 | One line of the page, in order. Start it with # to make it a heading; leave it empty for a gap. | Text |

#### Buttons

Up to two buttons under the text, each running a command as the player.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Button 1 text | The word on the first button under the text. Empty: no button. | Text |
| Button 1 command | For example /shop The command the first button runs as the player who clicks it, such as /shop or /spawn. | Text |
| Button 2 text | The word on the second button. Empty: no second button. | Text |
| Button 2 command | The command the second button runs as the player who clicks it. | Text |


### World map

`/tempest` → World map. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.map`.

Tempest's places show on every player's map and compass. Each kind of place has its own tab here. Own places: /places add <name>. Change or hide one place: /places.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Show Tempest places on the map | Off: no Tempest place (shops, slot machines, ATMs, crates, your own places) shows on any map or compass. Each kind can also be switched off on its own tab. | On or off |
| Players may pick what their map shows | With /places each player can leave out kinds of place. | On or off |
| Players may use /places | Lists the places nearest first. Admins can always use it. | On or off |


### Map: Your places

`/tempest` → Map: Your places. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.map`.

#### Your places

How these look on the map and who gets them. To change one of them, use /places.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Show on the map | Shows every place of this kind on players' maps. Off: they are hidden, but stay known, so switching it on brings them back. | On or off |
| Icon | A resource pack's own picture: put its file name in map.json. | A list |
| Colour | White shows the icon as it was drawn. | A colour |
| Name on the map | Empty: each place's own name. Written here, every one of them shows this. | Text |
| Big icon | A larger icon on the map, for places players should find easily. | On or off |
| On the compass too | These places also show on the compass at the top of the screen, not only on the map. | On or off |
| Who sees it (permission) | Empty: everyone. With a permission, only players or ranks who have it. | Text |
| Shown within (blocks) | Only players this near see them. 0: from anywhere. | 0 to 100000 |
| Only in these worlds | World names with commas between them. Empty: every world. | Text |

# Economy (Coins)

Wallets, coins, banks, daily rewards and ore and monster gold.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Welcome

- Coins are the money on this server. You earn them, keep them in your wallet, and spend them on what the server offers.
- Your balance: 12,901 copper.

**What the coins are worth**

- Every price is counted in copper. The other coins are worth:
- Coin Iron5,Coin Silver10,Coin Gold50,Coin Emerald100,Coin Diamond500

**On this server**

- -Wallet and ATM
- -Earning coins
- -Daily rewards
- -Money counter
- -Shared banks
- -Crates
- -Leaderboards
- -Shop
- -Quests and achievements
- -Slot machines
- -Lottery
- -Coinflip
- -Server events
- -Battle pass
- -Contracts
- -Jobs
- -Trade
- -Town
- -Town projects
- Pick a page on the left to read more. Open this screen any time with /coins.

**Admins also read:**

- Your balance: 24,800 copper.

### Wallet and ATM


**Your wallet**

- Coins in your wallet are safe. Coins you carry as items are not: you can drop or lose them like anything else in your bags.
- Open your wallet with /wallet (or /bal), or at any ATM.

**Taking coins out**

- Each coin in the wallet has buttons to take out 1, 10 or 100 of it.

**Putting coins in**

- Press "Put all my coins in" to put every coin you carry into your wallet. You can also hold a coin and right-click.

**Paying someone**

- Press "Pay a player" in the wallet and pick someone who is online, or type /pay <player> <amount>.

**History**

- The bottom of the wallet shows your latest gains and spending.

**ATMs**

- An ATM opens the same wallet, and pays out with a shower of coins. ATMs are shown on your map.
- Only admins can build ATMs on this server.

**Admins also read:**


**Your rank perks: VIP**

- Daily rewards +100%
- Shop prices -15%
- Shop sell prices +10%
- Payment fee -100%
- Quest rewards +50%

### Earning coins


**Fighting**

- Creatures you defeat drop coins. The tougher the creature, the more it drops.

**Mining**

- Ores sometimes drop coins when you mine them. Rarer ores drop more:
- Copper Ore: 10% chance of 1 copper
- Iron Ore: 10% chance of 2 copper
- Silver Ore: 15% chance of 5 copper
- Gold Ore: 15% chance of 10 copper
- Cobalt Ore: 20% chance of 20 copper
- Mithril Ore: 25% chance of 50 copper
- Adamantite Ore: 30% chance of 100 copper
- Thorium Ore: 20% chance of 30 copper
- Onyxium Ore: 25% chance of 60 copper
- Ores that players placed give no coins.

**Every day**

- Claim a free reward once a day with /daily. Come back on following days for bigger rewards.

**Selling**

- Sell items you do not need at a shop stall. See the Shop page.

**Luck**

- Try the slot machines or the lottery for a big win, but over time luck costs more than it pays.

**Other players**

- Trade with other players and pay each other with /pay or the wallet.

### Daily rewards

- Your reward for day 1 is ready! Open the calendar to claim it.

**How it works**

- Claim once a day with /daily. Each day in a row moves you along the calendar to a bigger reward. Miss a day and you start again from day 1. After day 7 the calendar starts over.

**The rewards**

- Day 1: 50 copper
- Day 2: 60 copper
- Day 3: 70 copper
- Day 4: 80 copper
- Day 5: 100 copper
- Day 6: 120 copper
- Day 7: 250 copper

### Shared banks


**Saving up together**

- A shared bank holds coins for a group: a town, a team, friends saving for something big. Open one with /bank (it costs 500 copper) and add your friends by name.

**Who can do what**

- Everyone in the bank can put coins in. Only the owner, and members the owner allows, can take coins out. The history shows who put in and took out what.

**Closing**

- Members can leave whenever they like. When the owner closes the bank, whatever is in it goes to the owner.

**Your banks**

- Steves_Team: 1,000 copper

### Leaderboards

- See who leads the server: the richest players, the top earners, the biggest single wins, and the best at the slot machines, the lottery and the shop, as far as this server has them.
- Each board shows the top 10, and your own place under it.
- Open them with /leaderboards (or /ranks).

### All commands


**Coinflip**

- /coinflip  (or /cf)  -Open the rooms: join one, watch a flip, or make your own
- /cf create <amount> [heads|tails]  -Open a room with a stake (heads if you pick no side)
- /cf join <player>  -Join a player's room with the same stake
- /cf cancel  -Close your open rooms; your stakes come back
- /cf list  -List the open rooms in chat

**Coins**

- /coins  -This help screen
- /wallet  (or /bal)  -Your wallet: withdraw, deposit, pay and history
- /pay <player> <amount>  -Give money to another player
- /daily  -The daily reward calendar
- /baltop  (or /rich)  -The richest players, in chat
- /bank  -Your shared bank accounts: save up together with friends
- /leaderboards  (or /ranks)  -Leaderboards: richest, top earners, biggest wins and more

**Contracts**

- /contracts  -Open the contracts board

**General**

- /guide  -This help screen
- /hud  -Show or hide your money counter; /hud top, left or low moves it
- /board  -Pick what your board on the right of the screen shows, or hide it
- /mail  -Your mailbox: rewards that did not fit or came while you were away
- /info  (or /rules, /serverinfo)  -The server's rules and info, from the admins
- /places  -Places on the world map, nearest first; pick what your map shows

**Crates**

- /crates  -Open crates for prizes
- /cratekey <player> <bronze|silver|gold> <amount>  -Give crate keys (admins)

**Events**

- /events  -What is on, what is coming, and the community goal

**Jobs**

- /jobs  -The jobs and your levels

**Lottery**

- /lottery  (or /lotto)  -The current round: pot, tickets and time left
- /lottery buy <amount>  -Buy tickets for the current round

**Battle pass**

- /pass  -Your tiers, rewards and XP this season

**Town projects**

- /projects  -See the projects and donate

**Quests**

- /quests  -Your quests and the quest board
- /achievements  (or /ach)  -Your achievements and how close you are

**Shop**

- /shop  -Open the shop (where the server allows it)
- /sell hand  -Sell the item in your hand (where the server allows /shop)
- /sell all  -Sell everything the shop buys (where the server allows /shop)

**Slot Machine**

- /jackpot  -How big the jackpot is right now
- /slotbet  -Choose how much each slot machine spin costs

**Town**

- /town  -What the town has unlocked and what it still needs

**Trade**

- /trade  -Trade with a player


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/atm` | `coins.admin.atm` | Admin: get an ATM in a design to place |
| `/baltop` (/rich) | Everyone | Show the richest players |
| `/bank` (/banks) | Everyone | Your shared bank accounts |
| `/bank open` | Everyone | Open one bank by name |
| `/coins` (/coinhelp) | Everyone | Help for coins, the wallet, banks and daily rewards |
| `/daily` | Everyone | Open the daily reward calendar |
| `/economy` (/eco) | `coins.admin.economy` | Admin: the economy screen, and changing balances |
| `/economy add` | `coins.admin.economy` | Give a player money |
| `/economy import` | `coins.admin.economy` | Copy every player's balance from another economy (Ecotale, or one through VaultUnlocked) |
| `/economy set` | `coins.admin.economy` | Set a player's balance to an amount |
| `/economy take` | `coins.admin.economy` | Take money from a player |
| `/leaderboards` (/leaderboard, /ranks) | Everyone | The richest players, biggest winners and best traders |
| `/pay` | Everyone | Send money from your wallet to another player |
| `/wallet` (/balance, /bal) | Everyone | Open your wallet: balance, coins, payments and history |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Coins

`/tempest` → Coins. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.coins`.

#### Earning

Coins players get from playing. Each ore's chance and worth are on the Ore Drops tab.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Mobs drop coins | When a player kills a mob. | On or off |
| Coins per point of health | Tougher mobs drop more. | 0 to 1000 |
| Most from one mob | 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Ores drop coins | Ores placed by players never do. | On or off |

#### Payments

Players paying each other with /pay or the wallet's Pay button.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players can pay each other | Off: /pay and the wallet's Pay button stop working. Admins can still move money with /eco. | On or off |
| Smallest payment | The lowest amount a player can send with /pay. Stops players from spamming each other with tiny payments. | 1 to 1000000000 |
| Fee (%) | Paid on top by the sender. It leaves the game. | 0 to 100 |

#### Leaderboards

/leaderboards and /baltop.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Open to everyone | Off: only admins can see them. | On or off |
| Players on each board | How many players each leaderboard and /baltop lists, from first place down. | 1 to 50 |

#### Shared banks

Players open a bank with /bank and save up together; the owner decides who may take coins out.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Shared banks | Off: no new banks. Existing ones can still be used and closed. | On or off |
| Price to open a bank | It leaves the game. 0 = free. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Banks one player can own | How many shared banks one player can open. Being a member of other players' banks does not count. | 1 to 100 |
| Members per bank | Besides the owner. | 1 to 200 |

#### Savings interest

Banks earn a little each day on the lowest balance they had since the last payout. A new bank earns from its second payout; a server that was down pays one day, not the days missed.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Savings interest | Off: no interest. New money: keep the rate low. | On or off |
| Rate (% a day) | What a bank earns each day, as a share of its lowest balance since the last payout. 1% on 10,000 is 100 a day. The limits below keep it from growing too fast. | 0 to 5 |
| Highest balance that earns | 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000000 |
| Most per bank a day | 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Most per owner a day | All banks of one owner together, so many small banks earn no more. 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Payout hour | Server time. | 0 to 23 |

#### Other

#### ATM designs

Crouch and press F on an ATM to change its design, or use /atm <design> to get one to place: classic, vault, teller, royal, crystal. Every design works the same.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players can craft ATMs | Off: only admins can. | On or off |
| Keep transaction logs (days) | 0 = forever. Old files are deleted when the server starts. | 0 to 36500 |


### Daily Rewards

`/tempest` → Daily Rewards. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.coins`.

#### Daily rewards

A reward for every day a player comes back. Players open the calendar with /daily.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Daily rewards | Off: no rewards and no calendar. | On or off |
| Open the calendar on join | Only when a reward is waiting. | On or off |
| Reminder under the coin counter | Shows "Daily reward ready!" | On or off |

#### Timing

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Hours between rewards | A bit under 24 lets players claim at the same time each day. | 0.1 to 8760 |
| Hours before the streak resets | Wait longer and the calendar starts again at day 1. | 0.1 to 8760 |

#### Rewards

What each day of the calendar pays. After day 7 it starts over.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 2 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 3 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 4 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 5 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 6 | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Day 7 (big one) | Reward | 0 to 1000000000 |

| Cobalt | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Mithril | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Adamantite | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Thorium | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Onyxium | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Prisma | Chance (%) | 0 to 100 |
| Worth | How much money one drop from this ore is worth. 0: this ore never drops coins. It counts for every rock this ore is found in. | 0 to 1000000000 |


### Currency

`/tempest` → Currency. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.coins`.

#### Money

What amounts are called in every message.

|---|---|---|
| Name | For 1 | Text |
| For 2 or more | The currency's name for amounts of 2 or more, such as coins in 250 coins. | Text |

#### Coins

Each coin's name, and how many of the smallest coin it is worth.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Copper Coin | Name | Text |
| Iron Coin | Name | Text |
| Worth | How many copper coins one of these is worth. Prices and balances are counted in copper, so this only changes how amounts are split into coins. | 1 to 1000000000000 |
| Silver Coin | Name | Text |
| Worth | How many copper coins one of these is worth. Prices and balances are counted in copper, so this only changes how amounts are split into coins. | 1 to 1000000000000 |
| Gold Coin | Name | Text |
| Worth | How many copper coins one of these is worth. Prices and balances are counted in copper, so this only changes how amounts are split into coins. | 1 to 1000000000000 |
| Emerald Coin | Name | Text |
| Worth | How many copper coins one of these is worth. Prices and balances are counted in copper, so this only changes how amounts are split into coins. | 1 to 1000000000000 |
| Diamond Coin | Name | Text |
| Worth | How many copper coins one of these is worth. Prices and balances are counted in copper, so this only changes how amounts are split into coins. | 1 to 1000000000000 |

#### Chat tags

The word in front of messages, and its colour. Leave a tag empty to hide it.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Wallet and payments | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the tag word in front of these chat messages. The example at the end of the row shows it. | A colour |
| Daily rewards | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the tag word in front of these chat messages. The example at the end of the row shows it. | A colour |
| Admin /eco | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the tag word in front of these chat messages. The example at the end of the row shows it. | A colour |


### Integrations

`/tempest` → Integrations. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.coins`.

#### VaultUnlocked

Lets plugins that use VaultUnlocked (player shops, auction houses, jobs, land claims...) pay and charge in these coins. Install VaultUnlocked to use it.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Be the economy for VaultUnlocked plugins | Their payments show in wallets and the /eco log under the plugin's name. | On or off |

#### Cassaforte

Lets plugins that use Cassaforte (SimpleJobs, Towny3D...) pay and charge in these coins, and use the shared banks. Install Cassaforte to use it.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Be the economy for Cassaforte plugins | Cassaforte keeps the first economy that connects; switching off takes a restart. | On or off |

#### Discord

Posts big moments to a Discord channel. In Discord: Edit channel, Integrations, Webhooks, New webhook, Copy webhook URL, and paste it below.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Webhook link | Empty: Discord is off. Keep it secret, anyone with it can post. | Text |
| Name in Discord | The name the posts appear under in your Discord channel, such as your server's name. Empty: the name the webhook was given in Discord. | Text |
| Jackpots | Posts when a player wins a jackpot. | On or off |
| Big slot machine wins | The size is set on the Slot Machine tab (Announce wins from). | On or off |
| Lottery winners | Posts who won each lottery drawing and how much. | On or off |
| Achievements | Posts when a player unlocks an achievement or finishes a quest that announces itself, and when the server finishes a server quest together. | On or off |
| News from other mods | Posts the other big moments: bounties, crate key parties, events starting and ending, finished town projects and unlocks, and battle pass seasons and players who finish them. | On or off |
| Send a test message when saved | Tick, then Save: a test message is posted if the link works. | On or off |

#### Placeholders

For scoreboards, chat formats and placeholder plugins: {coins_balance}, {coins_balance_formatted}, {coins_rank}, {coins_daily_streak}, {lottery_pot}, {lottery_time_left}, {slots_jackpot}, {quests_active}, {achievements_unlocked} and more (see API.md).


# Holograms

Floating text and top lists.

## What players read in /guide

- Admins: change, move or delete a hologram; /holo lists them
- Admins: a new hologram like another, where you stand
- Admins: floating text where you stand; | starts a new line, {placeholders} work
- Admins: a menu of all holograms: teleport to, edit and delete them
- Admins: a live top list where you stand, such as top:money 5; /holo boards lists them

## Commands

All of them need `holograms.admin`.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/holo boards` | List the top lists a hologram can show |
| `/holo copy` | Copy a hologram to where you stand |
| `/holo create` | Make a hologram where you stand |
| `/holo delete` | Delete a hologram |
| `/holo edit` | Change a hologram's text |
| `/holo` | Floating text: list, create, edit, move or delete holograms |
| `/holo menu` | Open the hologram menu: teleport to, edit and delete holograms |
| `/holo move` | Move a hologram to where you stand |


# Shop

The server shop, stalls and their shelves.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Shop


**Trading**

- Find a shop stall and press F. Stalls are shown on your map.
- Stalls can sell different things, so look around: a blacksmith has tools and weapons, a farmer has food.
- Buy takes one item, x10 takes 10. The price is for one item, in copper, paid from your wallet.
- Every day 3 items are 25% cheaper, the same for everyone. Look for DEAL in the shop: you can buy 16 of each at the deal price a day.
- Sell gives one item to the shop, All sells every one you carry. "Sell everything the shop buys" sells all of it at once.

**Prices**

- Hold an item: if the shop buys it, what it pays shows next to your coin counter.
- Worn tools and weapons sell for less.Broken ones cannot be sold until they are repaired.

**Good to know**

- Use the tabs at the top of the shop to see one kind of item at a time.
- Only admins can build shop stalls on this server.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/sell` | Everyone | Sell items to the shop |
| `/sell all` | Everyone | Sell every item the shop buys |
| `/sell hand` | Everyone | Sell the item in your hand |
| `/shop` | Everyone | Open the shop |
| `/shop link` | `shop.admin` | Make the block you look at a shop, selling as this stall kind |
| `/shop stall` | `shop.admin` | Get a stall to place |
| `/shop unlink` | `shop.admin` | Make the block you look at an ordinary block again |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Shop

`/tempest` → Shop. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.shop`.

#### Trading

Items and their prices are set in the shop itself, with Edit shop.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players can buy | Off: nobody can buy from the shop, and there are no daily deals. Selling still works if it is on. | On or off |
| Players can sell | Off: nobody can sell to the shop or use /sell. Buying still works if it is on. | On or off |
| /shop works anywhere | Off: players must go to a shop stall. | On or off |

#### Prices

Change every price at once, for a sale or a good time to sell.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Buy prices (%) | 80 = everything 20% off. | 1 to 10000 |
| Sell prices (%) | 150 = the shop pays half as much again. | 1 to 10000 |
| Bulk buy amount | The second amount button. | 2 to 1000 |

#### Supply and demand (Pro)

Prices move with what players trade: each item sold lowers what the shop pays for it, each item bought raises what it costs, and both drift back to the price you set. The shop never pays more or asks less than your set prices, so nobody can buy low and sell high. One item can keep a fixed price, or fall faster or slower: Edit shop, pick the item.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Prices move | On: prices follow what players trade, with the rules below. Off: every item always costs and pays exactly what you set in the shop. | On or off |
| Each one sold lowers it (%) | 0.5: after 64 sold the shop pays about 73%. | 0 to 50 |
| Never under (%) | The lowest the shop's pay for an item can fall, as a share of the price you set. 50: never under half. | 1 to 100 |
| Each one bought raises it (%) | 0 = buying never raises prices. | 0 to 50 |
| Never over (%) | The highest a buy price can climb, as a share of the price you set. 200: never more than double. | 100 to 1000 |
| Halfway back to normal in (hours) | How fast moved prices drift back to the ones you set. After this many hours half the change is gone, after twice as long three quarters. | 0.1 to 720 |

#### The shop's menu

What players see. Items, prices and categories are set in the shop itself, with Edit shop.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Empty: "Shop" in each player's language. | Text |
| Search box | On: a search box at the top of the shop, so players can type an item's name. | On or off |
| Sort list | On: players can sort the items themselves (cheapest, dearest, by name). | On or off |
| Category list | On: the categories you made show as a list players can click to see only that kind of item. | On or off |
| Deals banner | On: a line at the top of the shop names today's deals. | On or off |
| How many a player has | On: each item shows how many of it the player already carries, so they know what they can sell. | On or off |
| First sorted by | The order items are in when a player opens the shop. The shop's own order is the one you made in Edit shop. | The shop's own order, Cheapest first, Dearest first, By name |
| Items on one page | How many items fit on one page of the shop before players turn to the next page. | 4 to 60 |
| Third amount button | The shop has three amount buttons: 1, the bulk amount above, and this one. | 2 to 10000 |
| Most in one purchase | The most of one item a player can buy or sell at once. | 1 to 100000 |

#### Daily deals

A few items are cheaper each day, the same ones for everyone, picked anew at midnight. While an item is a deal, the shop pays no more for it than the deal price, so nobody can buy cheap and sell back.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Deals each day | 0 = no deals. | 0 to 10 |
| Deal discount (%) | How much cheaper a deal item is. 25: it costs three quarters of its normal price. | 1 to 90 |
| Deals are picked from | Choose the pool in the shop: Edit shop, pick an item, Daily deal. Items set to Always are a deal every day. | Any item in the shop, Only the deal pool |
| At the deal price, per player a day | How many of each deal one player may buy cheaper a day; more cost the normal price. 0 = no limit. | 0 to 100000 |

#### Worn items

Tools, weapons and armour that have lost durability.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Worn items sell for less | By how worn they are. Off: full price. | On or off |
| Refuse below condition (%) | 0 = only broken items are refused. | 0 to 100 |

#### Other

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Price tag under the coin counter | What the shop pays for the item in your hand. | On or off |
| Players can craft stalls | Off: only admins can. | On or off |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the shop's tag word in front of its chat messages. | A colour |

#### Free edition

The Pro edition adds: more stalls (Apothecary, Fishmonger, Tavern, Mage), prices that move with supply and demand.


### Stalls

`/tempest` → Stalls. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.stalls`.

#### Classic

Choose items for it in the shop: Edit shop, pick an item. One stall's own settings: This stall, at that stall.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Empty: the shop's own title. | Text |
| It sells | Which shop items this kind of stall offers. What fits: the items that suit this stall, plus any you chose for it in Edit shop. Only chosen: just the ones you picked. | Everything in the shop, What fits, plus chosen items, Only items chosen for it |
| Items on its shelves | On: real items from what this stall sells stand on its shelves while a player is near. Needs Tempest Holograms and Show items on stalls on the Stall shelves tab. | On or off |
| How many | How many items stand on this stall's shelves at once. | 1 to 3 |
