# Crates

Crates, keys, prizes and crate blocks.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Crates


**Opening crates**

- Type /crates. Each crate shows its price in copper and the prizes it can give.
- Press Open: the price comes out of your wallet, the strip spins (or a light runs round the prize board) and stops on your prize.
- Press x10 to open ten at once for ten times the price: you get all ten prizes straight away, listed by rarity.
- The prize is decided the moment you pay. Closing the page or pressing Skip does not change it, and you still get it.
- Some crates need a crate key instead of (or as well as) copper. Keys come from other crates and admins; right-click a key to see the crates.
- A crate marked (locked) is only for players with a certain rank.
- Crate blocks in the world open their crate when you press [F] on them. Hold the crate's key to open it at once.

**Prizes**

- Items go into your inventory; what does not fit drops at your feet. Copper go into your wallet.
- Every crate card shows its rarest prize and its chance.
- Some crates have a pity: after so many opens in a row without an Epic or better prize, the next one is always Epic or better. The card shows how close you are.
- Win a Epic prize or better and the whole server hears about it.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/cratekey` | `crates.admin` | Give a player crate keys |
| `/crates` (/crate) | Everyone | Open crates for prizes |
| `/crates log` | `crates.admin` | Admins: a player's newest crate openings, for prize questions |
| `/keyparty` | `crates.admin` | Give everyone online crate keys after a countdown (Pro) |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Crates

`/tempest` → Crates. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.crates`.

Make and change crates in /crates with Edit crates.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Crates are open | Off: nobody can open crates. | On or off |
| Spin time (seconds) | How long the strip runs before it stops on the prize. | 1 to 15 |
| Prize board time (seconds) | How long the light runs round the prize board (crates with the board style). | 1 to 15 |
| Sounds | Ticks while the strip runs, and a bigger jingle the rarer the prize. | On or off |
| Tell everyone about | Wins of this rarity or rarer are told to the whole server and sent to Discord. | No wins, Common wins and rarer, Uncommon wins and rarer, Rare wins and rarer, Epic wins and rarer, Legendary wins only |

#### The menu

What players see in /crates. The order of the crates is set in Edit crates.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Empty: "Crates" in each player's language. | Text |
| Search box | Over the list of crates. | On or off |

#### Rarities

A prize's rarity comes from its chance. Choose the colours, and from which chance a prize counts as each.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Common | The colour of Common prizes: their names in the crate menu, the spin, and the chat line and pop-up when one is won. | A colour |
| from (%) | A prize with at least this chance, and not enough for the rarity above, is Common. Prizes rarer than every row are Legendary. | 0 to 100 |
| Uncommon | The colour of Uncommon prizes: their names in the crate menu, the spin, and the chat line and pop-up when one is won. | A colour |
| from (%) | A prize with at least this chance, and not enough for the rarity above, is Uncommon. Prizes rarer than every row are Legendary. | 0 to 100 |
| Rare | The colour of Rare prizes: their names in the crate menu, the spin, and the chat line and pop-up when one is won. | A colour |
| from (%) | A prize with at least this chance, and not enough for the rarity above, is Rare. Prizes rarer than every row are Legendary. | 0 to 100 |
| Epic | The colour of Epic prizes: their names in the crate menu, the spin, and the chat line and pop-up when one is won. | A colour |
| from (%) | A prize with at least this chance, and not enough for the rarity above, is Epic. Prizes rarer than every row are Legendary. | 0 to 100 |
| Legendary | The colour of Legendary prizes: their names in the crate menu, the spin, and the chat line and pop-up when one is won. | A colour |

#### Chat

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the crates' tag word in front of their chat messages. | A colour |

#### Free edition

The Pro edition adds: any number of crates, pity counters, Open x10, rank and permission prizes, crates players open free every few hours, key parties for everyone online.


### Crate Blocks

`/tempest` → Crate Blocks. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.crateblocks`.

#### Crate blocks

Place a crate block, right-click it with crates.admin and choose its crate.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Text over crate blocks | The crate's name, price or key and how to open it (needs the free Holograms plugin). | On or off |
| Show the last rare win | A line with who last won a Rare or better prize from that crate. | On or off |
| Openings play at the block | The lid opens, prizes swirl up and the won one flies to the player, for everyone near. | On or off |
| Idle show seen from (blocks) | Prizes circle and sparkles rise only while a player is this close. | 4 to 64 |
| Circling prizes per crate | Each crate's own choice (Edit crates) says whether they circle at all. | 1 to 8 |
| Circling prizes on the server | At most this many at once, all crate blocks together (0 = none). | 0 to 500 |
| Seconds for one turn | How slowly the prizes circle the block. | 3 to 60 |
| Circle size (blocks) | How far from the middle of the crate block the prizes circle. | 0.4 to 3 |
| Circle height (blocks) | How high above the crate block the prizes circle. | 0 to 3 |
| Moves per second | How often a second the circling prizes move on. More looks smoother but sends players more updates. | 2 to 20 |
| Seconds between sparkles | Fewer moves and sparkles are easier on players' games. | 0.5 to 30 |
| Text height (blocks) | How high above the crate block its floating text (the crate's name and price) hangs. | 0.5 to 5 |
| The won prize lights up | It glows in its rarity's colour as it rises from the chest. | On or off |
| Players can craft crate blocks | Off: only admins (coins.admin.craft) can craft them. | On or off |

#### Key parties (Pro)

Everyone online gets crate keys at once, after a ten-second countdown in chat. Start one with /keyparty [key] [amount], or have one every few hours.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| A key party every (hours) | 0 = only when an admin types /keyparty. | 0 to 168 |
| Key | bronze, silver, gold or any item id. | Text |
| Keys each | How many of the key above each online player gets in a key party: the timed ones, and /keyparty typed without a key and amount. | 1 to 64 |
| Players online for one by itself | A timed key party waits until at least this many players are online, so keys are not given to an empty server. /keyparty always works. | 1 to 500 |


# Quests

Quests, achievements, ranks, the daily sweep and server quests.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Quests and achievements


**Achievements**

- Goals for the whole time you play, like mining 100 ores or hitting the jackpot. They count by themselves, and each pays a reward once. Some are secret until you find them.

**Quests**

- Pick quests from the quest board in /quests: you can do 3 at a time. Daily and weekly quests come back when they reset, so you can earn them again.

**Quest journal**

- Every finished quest and achievement gives quest points: your rank grows from Wanderer to Legend, and higher ranks earn more from quests. Finish 3 daily quests in a day for the daily sweep bonus, bigger for every day in a row. The featured quest of the day pays more.

**Server quests**

- Server quests count everyone's progress together. When the target is reached, everyone who helped enough is paid, and the top helper gets more.

**Progress**

- The bars show how far along you are. When you finish, the reward goes straight into your wallet. Your first quest also shows under your coin counter.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/achievements` (/achievement, /ach) | Everyone | Your achievements and how close you are |
| `/quests` (/quest) | Everyone | Your quests and the quest board |
| `/questtrigger` | `quests.admin` | Count a custom quest trigger for a player |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Quests

`/tempest` → Quests. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.quests`.

#### Making achievements and quests

Open /quests and use the Edit (admin) tab. Admins need the permission quests.admin.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players choose their quests | From the quest board. Off: every quest counts at once. | On or off |
| Most quests at once | While players choose their quests. | 1 to 50 |
| Play time only while moving | Standing still (AFK) does not count towards play time goals. | On or off |

#### Quest journal

Ranks, the daily sweep, the featured quest and server quests: what brings players back each day.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Quest points and ranks | Every finished goal gives points; Wanderer, Adventurer, Pathfinder, Hero, Champion and Legend. A new rank is told to everyone. | On or off |
| Ranks raise quest rewards | From +2% for Adventurers to +10% for Legends. | On or off |
| Daily sweep: daily quests to finish | Finish this many of the day's daily quests for a bonus. 0 = off. | 0 to 20 |
| Daily sweep bonus | Extra money once a day for a player who finishes enough of that day's daily quests (the number is set above). 0: no sweep bonus. | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Streak: more each day in a row (%) | The sweep bonus grows for each day in a row a player earns it. 10: day 2 pays 10% more, day 3 20% more, and so on. | 0 to 500 |
| Streak grows for (days) | After this many days in a row the sweep bonus stops growing and stays at its highest. | 1 to 60 |
| Featured quest pays (times) | One daily quest a day, the same for everyone. 1 = no featured quest. | 1 to 10 |
| Server quests: top helper gets more (%) | When the server finishes a server quest together, the player who did the most gets this much more than the others. | 0 to 1000 |
| Server quests: least share to be paid (%) | Of the target. Players who did less are thanked but not paid, so nobody earns by doing one thing. | 0 to 100 |

#### Achievements

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Announce unlocks to everyone | Each goal can override this in the editor. Secret goals stay secret. | On or off |

#### On screen

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Big title when something is done | "QUEST COMPLETE" or "ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED". | On or off |
| Pop-up with the icon | A small notice at the side of the screen when something is done. | On or off |
| Sounds | A short jingle when something is done, and coins when it pays. | On or off |
| Quest under the coin counter | The player's first quest and how far along it is. | On or off |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the quests' tag word in front of their chat messages. | A colour |

#### Free edition

The Pro edition adds: any number of achievements and quests, a daily rotation: a few daily quests a day, picked from all of yours.


# Battle pass

Seasons, tiers, free and premium rewards.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Battle pass

- Season 1: 30 tiers. Each tier has a free reward and a premium reward.
- Earn XP by finishing quests, playing, logging in each day and playing the server's games.
- Unlock premium in /pass for 5,000 copper of in-game money.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/pass` (/battlepass) | Everyone | Open the battle pass: tiers, rewards and your XP |
| `/pass premium` | `pass.admin` | Give a player the premium track for this season (admins) |
| `/pass xp` | `pass.admin` | Give a player pass XP, or take it with a negative amount (admins) |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Pass

`/tempest` → Pass. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.pass`.

#### The season

Make the tiers in /pass, Edit tab (permission pass.admin). A new season starts there too.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Pass is on | Off: /pass says so and no XP counts. | On or off |
| Season name | Shown at the top of /pass. | Text |
| Season length (days) | From the day it started. 0 = no end. Rewards can still be claimed after it ends. | 0 to 365 |
| XP for each tier | How much pass XP a player needs to go up one tier. Every tier needs the same amount. Higher: the season takes longer to finish. | 1 to 1000000 |
| Premium price | In-game money only. 0 = not for sale; the permission pass.premium always gives it. | 0 to 1000000000 |

#### Where XP comes from

Quests count when the Quests plugin is installed.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Daily quest done | Pass XP for each daily quest a player finishes. Needs Tempest Quests. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Weekly quest done | Pass XP for each weekly quest a player finishes. Needs Tempest Quests. | 0 to 1000000 |
| One-time quest done | Pass XP for each one-time quest a player finishes. Needs Tempest Quests. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Achievement unlocked | Pass XP for each achievement a player unlocks. Needs Tempest Quests. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Each minute played | Pass XP for every minute a player is online. The next setting limits how much this gives in a day. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Play XP a day, at most | The most pass XP one player can get from play time in one day. The other sources have no daily limit. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Play time only while moving | Standing still (AFK) earns nothing. | On or off |
| First login of the day | Pass XP the first time a player joins on a new day. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Each game played | A slot spin, lottery ticket purchase, crate or coinflip. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Game XP a day, at most | The most pass XP one player can get from games (slots, lottery tickets, crates, coinflip) in one day. | 0 to 1000000 |

#### The /pass page

How players see the tiers. Each player can switch the layout in /pass.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Start in the list view | Off: the track, tiers side by side with a card per reward. On: a row per tier. | On or off |
| Tiers on a page of the track | 8 fit side by side; more scroll sideways. | 4 to 20 |
| Animations | The XP bar filling up, glowing rewards, bursts, pop-ups and Claim all turning the cards over. | On or off |
| Free track's name | Empty: FREE in each player's language. At most 16 letters. | Text |
| Premium track's name | Empty: PREMIUM in each player's language; for example VIP or Gold. | Text |

#### On screen

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tell everyone when someone finishes | A chat line when a player reaches the last tier. | On or off |
| Tier under the coin counter | On: players see their pass tier and how far they are to the next one in a line under their coin counter. | On or off |
| Sounds | On: a sound when a player reaches a tier, claims a reward or buys the premium pass. | On or off |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the pass's tag word in front of its chat messages. | A colour |

#### Pro edition

Thank you for supporting Pass.


# Events

Server events with boosts, community goals and the server fund.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Server events

- Server events make things better for a while: more gold from monsters and ores, bigger rewards, more battle pass XP, better shop prices.
- Next: Monster Hunt. /events shows when.

**How events work**

- During an event, what you do for its goal counts for the whole server. When the goal is reached, everyone who did at least 1% of it gets the reward. The three players who did the most win prizes at the end.

**Overdrive**

- Some events have stages: after the goal comes a bigger one. Each stage makes every boost stronger and pays the goal reward again.

**The server fund**

- Everyone can put money in the server fund (/events, or /events give 500). When it is full, Gold Rush starts for the whole server.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/events` (/event) | Everyone | Server events: what is on, what is coming, and the community goal |
| `/events extend` | `events.admin` | More or fewer minutes for the event that is on (admins) |
| `/events give` (/fund) | Everyone | Put money in the server fund: when it is full, an event starts for everyone |
| `/events list` | `events.admin` | Every event and the next starts (admins) |
| `/events start` | `events.admin` | Start an event now (admins) |
| `/events stop` | `events.admin` | Stop the event that is on (admins) |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Events

`/tempest` → Events. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.events`.

Server events boost the Tempest plugins for a while. Make and schedule them in /events, Manage.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Events are on | Off: nothing starts, and a running event stops boosting and counting. | On or off |

#### Telling players

How players hear about events.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Big title on screen | When an event starts, reaches its goal and ends. | On or off |
| Chat messages | On: everyone gets chat lines when an event is coming, starts and ends. Off: no event chat lines; titles and sounds have their own switches. | On or off |
| Sounds | On: everyone hears a sound when an event is coming, when it starts, and when a goal or stage is reached. | On or off |
| Warn before a start (minutes) | Players are told this long before a scheduled event. 0: not told. | 0 to 120 |
| Show on the board | The event, its time left and the goal on the Tempest board (players can hide it in /board). | On or off |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Tag colour | The colour of the events' tag word in front of their chat messages. | A colour |

#### Server fund

Players put money in together; when it is full, the event below starts for everyone. The money leaves the economy.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Server fund | On: players give money to the server fund with /events give <amount>. When it is full, the event below starts for everyone, at once or as soon as the event that is on ends. | On or off |
| Event it starts | The event that starts when the server fund is full. Make and change events in /events, Manage. | Gold Rush, Monster Hunt, XP Frenzy, Market Day, Lucky Hour |
| Money to fill it | How much money the players must give together. When it is full the event starts and the fund starts again from 0. The money leaves the economy. | 1 to 1000000000 |
| Tell everyone about gifts of (% of the fund) | 0: never. | 0 to 100 |

#### Lucky events

Now and then, by chance, an event starts by itself while nothing else is on.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Lucky events | On: once an hour there is a chance the event below starts by itself, when no other event is on. | On or off |
| Which event | The event a lucky roll starts. | Gold Rush, Monster Hunt, XP Frenzy, Market Day, Lucky Hour |
| Chance each hour (%) | The chance, checked once an hour, that a lucky event starts. 10: about one every 10 hours. | 0 to 100 |
| Players online at least | Fewer players online: no lucky event, so nobody misses it. | 0 to 500 |


# Contracts and bounties

Player contracts, server orders, the market, ranks and bounties.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Contracts

- The contracts board: the server and other players want items and pay for them. Deliver what you have, or post an order for what you need.

**Delivering**

- Open /contracts and press DELIVER on a contract: the items leave your inventory and you are paid at once. Server orders start again every day or week.

**Posting**

- In the Post tab, pick an item, how many and the total reward. The reward is taken when you post (plus a 5% fee) and paid to whoever delivers. Collect the items in My contracts; money not used comes back when the contract ends.

**The market**

- Put items up for sale in the Market tab: they wait there and buyers pay you at once. Buy with one click, cheapest first; the 7-day prices show what things are worth.

**Bounties**

- In the Bounties tab, put money on another player. It is taken when you post (plus a 10% fee) and paid to whoever kills them. If nobody does, it comes back when the bounty ends, without the fee.

**Contractor ranks**

- Every item you deliver to a server order counts towards your rank: Courier, Trader, Merchant and Tycoon earn more from server orders.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/contracts` (/contract) | Everyone | Open the contracts board: deliver items for money, or ask for the items you need |
| `/contracts bounties` (/bounty) | Everyone | Bounties: put money on a player, or hunt one down |
| `/contracts list` | `contracts.admin` | Admins: the board in chat |
| `/contracts mine` | Everyone | Your contracts: collect what was delivered |
| `/contracts post` | Everyone | Post a contract: ask for items and pay for them |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Contracts

`/tempest` → Contracts. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.contracts`.

A contracts board: players and the server post item orders, others deliver and get paid. Server orders are made in /contracts, Manage.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Contracts are on | Off: nothing can be posted or delivered. Contracts keep their money and items until it is on again. | On or off |
| Server orders | The server's own orders are on the board. They pay from nothing and take items out of the game. | On or off |
| Contractor rank bonus | Players who delivered more earn up to 10% more from server orders. | On or off |

#### Players' contracts

Players post orders; the reward is taken when they post and paid out as items arrive.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players may post contracts | On: players can post their own orders on the contract board. Off: players cannot post new ones; the server's orders stay. | On or off |
| Open contracts per player | How many contracts one player can have on the board at once. 0: players cannot post any. | 0 to 100 |
| Posting fee (%) | Taken when posting and never given back: it takes money out of the economy. | 0 to 50 |
| Least pay per item | The lowest reward a contract can offer for each item, so the board does not fill with worthless orders. 64 items at 5 needs a reward of at least 320. | 1 to 1000000 |
| Most items in one contract | The most items one contract can ask for. | 1 to 1000000 |
| Largest reward | The most money one contract can offer. It also limits how much one player can put on one bounty. | 1 to 1000000000 |
| How long contracts and offers last (hours) | Players pick one of these. Separate with commas, e.g. 24, 72, 168. | Text |
| Items nobody may ask for or sell | Item ids separated with commas. Coins never can. | Text |

#### Permissions

Off: everyone may. On: only players with the permission.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Posting contracts needs contracts.post | On: only players with the permission contracts.post can post contracts (admins always can). Give it to a rank in your ranks plugin. Off: everyone can. | On or off |
| Selling on the market needs contracts.sell | On: only players with the permission contracts.sell can put items up for sale on the market (admins always can). Buying stays open to everyone. Off: everyone can sell. | On or off |

#### Telling players

Chat lines and sounds.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Announce new contracts | One chat line to everyone (at most once a minute per player), and when server orders start again. | On or off |
| Sounds | On: a sound when a player posts, delivers or sells, and when they are paid. | On or off |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Tag colour | The colour of the contracts' tag word in front of their chat messages. | A colour |


### Market & ranks

`/tempest` → Market & ranks. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.marketranks`.

#### Market

Players put items up for sale; others buy at once, cheapest first. Prices of the last 7 days are shown.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Market is on | On: players can sell items to each other on the market in /contracts. Off: nobody can put up or buy offers. | On or off |
| Sales tax (%) | Kept from each sale; the seller gets the rest. It takes money out of the economy. | 0 to 50 |
| Offers per player | How many items one player can have up for sale on the market at once. 0: players cannot sell. | 0 to 100 |
| Highest price per item | The most a player can ask for one item on the market. | 1 to 1000000000 |

#### Contractor ranks

By items delivered; the bonus is on server orders. Leave a name empty for the built-in one in each player's language.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Rank 1 name | Newcomer | Text |
| Rank 1: bonus (%) | Players at this rank get this much more for delivering to server orders. Players' own contracts pay what they offer. | 0 to 100 |
| Rank 2 name | Courier | Text |
| Rank 2: items delivered | How many items a player must have delivered in all to reach this rank. | 1 to 10000000 |
| Rank 2: bonus (%) | Players at this rank get this much more for delivering to server orders. Players' own contracts pay what they offer. | 0 to 100 |
| Rank 3 name | Trader | Text |
| Rank 3: items delivered | How many items a player must have delivered in all to reach this rank. | 1 to 10000000 |
| Rank 3: bonus (%) | Players at this rank get this much more for delivering to server orders. Players' own contracts pay what they offer. | 0 to 100 |
| Rank 4 name | Merchant | Text |
| Rank 4: items delivered | How many items a player must have delivered in all to reach this rank. | 1 to 10000000 |
| Rank 4: bonus (%) | Players at this rank get this much more for delivering to server orders. Players' own contracts pay what they offer. | 0 to 100 |
| Rank 5 name | Tycoon | Text |
| Rank 5: items delivered | How many items a player must have delivered in all to reach this rank. | 1 to 10000000 |
| Rank 5: bonus (%) | Players at this rank get this much more for delivering to server orders. Players' own contracts pay what they offer. | 0 to 100 |


### Bounties

`/tempest` → Bounties. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.bounties`.

Players put money on each other; whoever kills that player collects it. Only for servers where players can fight.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Bounties are on | Off: the tab is gone and kills pay nothing. Bounties already posted keep their money, and it still comes back when they end. | On or off |
| Smallest bounty | The least money a player can put on another player's head. | 1 to 1000000000 |
| Posting fee (%) | Taken when posting and never given back: it takes money out of the economy and makes moving money between friends cost something. | 0 to 50 |
| Bounties per player | How many players one player may have a bounty on at once. The largest bounty and how long one lasts are in the Contracts tab. | 0 to 100 |

#### Fair play

Against camping a respawn and friends farming each other.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Protection after a claim (minutes) | Nobody collects on that player for this long. New bounties can still be posted. | 0 to 1440 |
| Same hunter, same player (hours) | One hunter cannot collect on the same player again for this long. | 0 to 720 |

#### Telling players

Chat lines and the Tempest board.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Announce bounties | One chat line to everyone when a bounty is posted or claimed, and in the Discord feed. The player it is on always hears. | On or off |
| Posting bounties needs contracts.bounty | On: only players with the permission contracts.bounty can post bounties. Off: everyone can. | On or off |


# Town projects

Buildings the players build together.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Town projects

- The town builds together: every donation raises the building on its plot, block by block.

**Donating**

- /projects shows what each project needs. GIVE hands over what you carry, up to what is still needed.

**Staying safe**

- Plots under construction cannot be changed by hand. If a block would land on you, you are moved aside; /projects out takes you out of a plot. A cancelled project gives everything back.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/projects` (/project) | Everyone | See the town projects and donate to them |
| `/projects cancel` | `projects.admin` | Cancel a project: everything goes back |
| `/projects coins` | `projects.admin` | Set the coin goal of a project |
| `/projects finish` | `projects.admin` | Finish a project now: the whole building goes up |
| `/projects list` | `projects.admin` | List every project |
| `/projects material` | `projects.admin` | Change a material of a project (0 takes it off) |
| `/projects new` | `projects.admin` | Pick a prefab and place a new project |
| `/projects out` | Everyone | Leave a plot under construction |
| `/projects pause` | `projects.admin` | Pause a project |
| `/projects place` | `projects.admin` | Go back to the plot you are placing |
| `/projects plan` | `projects.admin` | Mark a plot for a prefab where you stand |
| `/projects prefabs` | `projects.admin` | Find prefabs by name |
| `/projects remove` | `projects.admin` | Take an ended project off the list |
| `/projects resume` | `projects.admin` | Go on with a paused project |
| `/projects reward` | `projects.admin` | Add a console command run for each donor at the end |
| `/projects rewarditems` | `projects.admin` | Pro: items every donor gets at the end (none clears them) |
| `/projects start` | `projects.admin` | Start the project on the marked plot |
| `/projects stop` | `projects.admin` | Stop a project: what stands stays |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Projects

`/tempest` → Projects. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.projects`.

Players donate items and coins, and a building rises block by block on a marked plot. Make one with /projects new: pick a prefab, move its ghost, start.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Projects are on | Off: no donations, and the builders rest. Plots keep their guard, money and items. | On or off |
| Blocks placed each second | How fast donated blocks go up. Lower it if a big plot slows the server. | 4 to 2000 |
| Move players out of the way | On: a player a block would land on goes to the nearest safe spot beside the plot. Off: the block waits until they step away. | On or off |

#### New projects

Used when a project starts. Change one project with /projects material and /projects coins.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Materials asked for (%) | 100: one item for each block of the building. | 1 to 1000 |
| Different items asked for | The most used come first. What only creative mode has is never asked for. Lower this for a shorter list: what is left out, like a single door, goes up for free at the end. | 1 to 64 |
| Share paid by coins (%) | With a coin goal: how much of the building the coins pay for. | 0 to 100 |
| Any item of the same kind counts | On: any wood planks count for the planks asked for. The building keeps the blocks of its plan, and a project's page changes this. | On or off |
| Keep water on the plot | For docks and wells: water that stands on the plot stays, and the blocks of the building go in around it. The placing panel can choose for each project. | On or off |

#### Telling players

What everyone sees.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Announce finished buildings | On: everyone gets a chat line when a town project is finished, with how many players helped. It also goes to Discord when that is set up. | On or off |
| Progress text over the plot | Needs Tempest Holograms. | On or off |
| Show the finished building as a ghost | A see-through plan stands on the plot, and the real blocks fill it. Off: no project shows one, whatever is set for it. | On or off |
| Ghost of a new project | Off: nothing shows on the plot, and real blocks appear as people donate. The placing panel can choose for each project, and so can a project's own page. | Everyone, Only players in creative mode, Off: real blocks only |
| New projects cannot be walked through | Invisible solid blocks hold the walls that are still to come, so the plan feels solid. Only for a plan everyone sees. Doorways stay open, and a project's page changes it. | On or off |
| Frame around a plot under way | Everyone near sees where a site is, even with its plan hidden. | On or off |
| Colour of the frame | The colour of the frame around a plot that is being built. | A colour |
| How far the frame shows (blocks) | Players farther away than this do not see the frame. | 16 to 512 |

#### Pro edition

Thank you for supporting Projects.


### Placing

`/tempest` → Placing. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.placing`.

#### The look

What an admin starts with in the placing panel. The VIEW tab changes the ghost, the box and the other plots while placing.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|

| Outline thickness (blocks) | How thick the outline's lines are. The site frame uses it too. | 0.02 to 1 |
| Colour when it fits | The outline's colour while the building can go where it is. | A colour |
| Colour when it does not | The outline's colour while something is in the way. | A colour |
| See-through box over the plot (%) | How solid the coloured box around the plot is. 0: no box. | 0 to 100 |
| Show the plots nearby | Outlines of the other projects, to line a street up. | On or off |
| Colour of the plots nearby | The outline colour of other projects' plots near the one being placed, so they do not overlap. | A colour |
| Red blocks where it goes into something | Only the admin sees them. They show what the building would replace, and in a second colour what stops it from starting. | On or off |
| Colour of those blocks | The colour of the blocks the building would replace. | A colour |
| Colour of what stops it | The colour of the blocks that stop the building from starting where it is. | A colour |
| How solid those blocks look (%) | How solid the coloured blocks look. Low: see-through, high: solid. | 5 to 100 |

#### Moving

How the plot moves.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Step sizes | The sizes the STEP button goes through, in blocks, such as 1, 5, 10, 25. | Text |
| Start on the ground | A new plot settles where it fits the land best. Off: it starts at the admin's feet. | On or off |
| How far AIM reaches (blocks) | AIM moves the plot to the block the admin looks at. It finds blocks up to this far away. | 8 to 256 |
| Gap left by BESIDE (blocks) | BESIDE moves the plot right next to the nearest other plot, with this many blocks between them. 0: wall to wall. | 0 to 64 |

#### The camera

The views of the placing panel.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| View to start in | The camera the placing panel opens with: the admin's own eyes, straight down from the top, or from an angle. | Normal, From the top, From an angle |
| Closest zoom (blocks) | How close the top and angled views can zoom in. | 4 to 64 |
| Farthest zoom (blocks) | How far the top and angled views can zoom out. | 4 to 256 |
| Zoom step (blocks) | How much one click on zoom in or out moves the camera. | 1 to 64 |
| Zoom to start at (blocks) | A big building starts farther away, so all of it is in view. | 4 to 256 |


# Town

Features the town unlocks, and the mayor.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Town

- The whole server is one town, and it unlocks new features as it grows. /town shows what is unlocked and what is still needed.

**How things unlock**

- Some unlocks wait for a town building to be finished: donate to it with /projects. Others come on a date or after another unlock.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/mayor` | Everyone | Town: who the mayor is and how to become mayor |
| `/mayor boost` | Everyone | Mayor: give everyone a boost for a while |
| `/mayor clear` | Everyone | Admins: the town has no mayor until the term ends |
| `/mayor fine` | Everyone | Mayor: fine a player who misbehaved |
| `/mayor reward` | Everyone | Mayor: reward a player who helped the town |
| `/mayor set` | Everyone | Admins: make an online player mayor until the term ends |
| `/town` | Everyone | Town: what the town has unlocked and what it still needs |
| `/town lock` | Everyone | Admins: keep an unlock locked |
| `/town unlock` | Everyone | Admins: keep an unlock unlocked |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Town

`/tempest` → Town. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.town`.

The town unlocks features as it grows. Make and change unlocks in /town, MANAGE tab; this tab is for all of them.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Town decides what is unlocked | Off: every feature is on, as if Town were not installed. Unlocks keep their state for when it is on again. | On or off |
| Players see locked unlocks | On: /town shows what is still locked and what it needs. Off: only what the town has. | On or off |

#### Telling players

When something is unlocked or locked.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Announce in chat | On: everyone gets a chat line when the town unlocks something or it is locked again. It also goes to Discord when that is set up. | On or off |
| Seconds before announcing it again | Against chat floods. Console commands of an unlock always run. | 5 to 86400 |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour of the tag | The colour of the town's tag word in front of its chat messages. | A colour |

#### Mayor

Each term the player who gave most to town projects becomes mayor, with a few small powers you limit here. Only in-game donations count. Players see it all with /mayor; admins can /mayor set or /mayor clear.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| The town has a mayor | On: at the end of each term, the player who gave most to town projects in that term becomes mayor for the next one. Off: no mayor and no mayor powers. | On or off |
| A term lasts (days) | How long one mayor's term is. Donations are counted again from 0 for each term. | 1 to 90 |
| Least given to become mayor | In points: one per coin, and the next setting per item. | 0 to 10000000 |
| Points per item given | Points for each item a player gives to a project. Each coin given is one point. | 0 to 10000 |
| The mayor's boost | For everyone online, started with /mayor boost. | Jobs pay, Mob coins, Ore coins, Quest reward, Shop sell, Daily reward, Pass xp, Shop discount, Contract pay |
| Boost (%) | How much the mayor's boost raises what it boosts. | 1 to 100 |
| For (minutes) | How long one mayor's boost lasts. | 1 to 1440 |
| Boosts each term | How many boosts the mayor can start in one term. 0: the mayor cannot start boosts. | 0 to 20 |
| Reward (coins) | /mayor reward <player>: new coins for a player who helped. Never the mayor, each player once a term. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Rewards each term | How many players the mayor can reward in one term. 0: no rewards. | 0 to 20 |
| Fine (coins) | /mayor fine <player>: never more than they have, never an admin; only the two of them are told. Every use is in the admin log. | 0 to 1000000 |
| Fines each term | How many players the mayor can fine in one term. 0: no fines. | 0 to 20 |

#### Buildings

Tempest Projects is installed: an unlock can wait for a building to be finished.


# Jobs

Paid work with job levels.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Jobs

- Take a job and get paid for your work: mining ores, cutting trees, harvesting crops, hunting mobs.
- Each job has its own level: the higher it is, the more it pays. /jobs join miner takes one.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/jobs` | Everyone | Jobs: the jobs, your levels, and how to take one |
| `/jobs info` | Everyone | Your jobs and what they paid today |
| `/jobs join` | Everyone | Take a job |
| `/jobs leave` | Everyone | Leave a job |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Jobs

`/tempest` → Jobs. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.jobs`.

Players take jobs with /jobs join and are paid for their work, more at higher job levels. What each job pays for is edited on the /jobs page (EDIT tab, for admins).

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Jobs is on | Off: no job pays | On or off |

#### Holding jobs

Players with tempest.jobs.slots.2 (up to .10) hold more.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Jobs a player holds | How many jobs one player can have at the same time. Players with the permission tempest.jobs.slots.2 (up to .10) can hold that many instead. When all are taken, the /jobs page offers to swap their lowest-level job for the new one. | 1 to 10 |
| Keep the level when leaving | On: a player who leaves a job keeps its level and XP, and has them back when they take it again. Off: leaving starts that job over at level 1. | On or off |
| Minutes before taking a job again | After leaving a job, a player waits this long before taking the same job again. Stops players hopping between jobs for the best pay. 0 lets them take it back at once. | 0 to 43200 |

#### Levels

Job XP for the next level is base x level ^ power.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Highest job level | No job goes above this level. With Tempest Town, the guild hall setting below can hold levels lower until the town builds it. | 1 to 1000 |
| XP base | The job XP the first levels need. Each level needs base x level ^ power: with 100 and power 1.5, level 10 needs about 3,160 XP. Higher means slower levels. | 1 to 1000000 |
| XP power | 1 is the same XP every level; 1.5 grows | 1 to 3 |
| More pay per level (%) | Level 50 at 2% pays double | 0 to 100 |

#### Paying

Earnings are added up and paid together, held to the caps.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Pay every (seconds) | Job pay is added up and paid in one go every so many seconds, so the wallet log is not flooded with one line per block. The hourly caps are checked on each payment. | 1 to 60 |
| Most a player earns an hour | 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Most the server pays an hour | All players together; 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Town bonus (%) | With Tempest Town, once an unlock gives jobs:town_bonus | 0 to 1000 |
| Pay scale | All job pay times this: 0.5 halves it, 2 doubles it | 0.01 to 100 |
| Highest level without the guild hall | 0 is no such limit; a town unlock (jobs:guild_hall) lifts it | 0 to 1000 |

#### Telling players

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tell level-ups | On: a chat line ("Miner level 12!") when a job level goes up. The sound is set on its own below. | On or off |
| A chat line for each payment | Off: the money counter shows it | On or off |
| Job XP bar while working | A bar under the money counter for a few seconds after each payment | On or off |
| Job XP bar: seconds shown | How long the job's XP bar stays under the money counter after the last bit of work. | 1 to 60 |
| Level-up sound | The sound a player hears when a job levels up. Pick none for silence. | SFX_Discovery_Z1_Short, None |


### Jobs bonuses

`/tempest` → Jobs bonuses. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.jobsbonuses`.

#### Bonuses

Streaks, felled trees and what the server's contracts want pay more.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Streak: seconds between blocks | 0 is no streaks | 0 to 60 |
| Streak: more per block (%) | Each block mined or chopped within the streak time of the last one adds this much to its pay, so steady work pays more. Example: 5% makes the 4th block in a row pay 15% more. | 0 to 100 |
| Streak: the most (%) | A streak never adds more than this, however long it runs. | 0 to 500 |
| Streak sound | On: a chime that rises with each block of a streak, so players hear it building. | On or off |

| Tool tiers, worst first | Each tier above the first adds a job's tool bonus once | Text |
| Felled tree: more per log (%) | Cutting a whole tree (its last log) pays this much more of what its logs paid, for each log. Example: 2.5% on a 20-log tree adds 50%. | 0 to 100 |
| Felled tree: the most (%) | 0 is no tree bonus | 0 to 500 |
| Felled tree: blocks around a log | How far sideways from a cut log the rest of the tree is looked for. Larger finds wide trees, but can join two trees standing close together. | 1 to 8 |
| Felled tree: blocks above a log | How far up from a cut log the rest of the tree is looked for. Raise it for very tall trees. | 4 to 64 |
| Wanted by contracts (%) | With Tempest Contracts: work bringing in an item on the board pays this much more | 0 to 1000 |
| Builder: minutes a block must stand | A builder is paid for a block only when it is still standing this many minutes after it was placed, so placing and breaking blocks over and over pays nothing. | 1 to 120 |

#### Mob farms

Many kills of one kind of mob in one spot pay less and less.

| Setting | What it does | Values |

| Minutes counted | Mob farms: kills of one kind of mob in one spot are counted over this many minutes. Older kills are forgotten. | 1 to 240 |
| Kills that pay in full | Mob farms: this many kills of one kind of mob in one spot pay in full; after that, each kill pays less. | 1 to 10000 |
| Size of a spot (blocks) | Mob farms: kills this close together count as one spot. A farm usually kills in a small area; normal hunting moves around. | 4 to 256 |
| Each kill after pays less (%) | Mob farms: after the kills that pay in full, each further kill in the same spot pays this much less than the one before. | 0 to 100 |
| Never under (%) | Mob farms: a kill never pays less than this share of its normal pay, however many there were. | 0 to 100 |
| Mobs that never pay | Parts of mob names, commas between: Chicken, Dummy | Text |

# Trade

Safe trades between players.

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Trade

- Trade items and coins safely with another player, in a window where both must agree.

**How to trade**

- /trade <player> asks them; they answer /trade <your name> or /trade accept. In the window, click an item of yours, choose how many and add it; add coins if you like. When both press Ready, a short countdown runs and the trade is done.

**Why nobody can be cheated**

- What you offer is held safely until the trade is done, and goes back if it is cancelled, the window closes or a player leaves. Any change makes both players not ready and stops the countdown, so nobody can swap an item at the last moment.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/trade` | Everyone | Trade with a player: /trade <player>, or accept, deny, toggle, open |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Trade

`/tempest` → Trade. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.trade`.

Safe trading between players: a trade window for items and coins, both confirm.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Trade is on | Off: /trade does nothing. | On or off |

#### Where players must be

Trades are safe anywhere: offered items are held by the server until the trade is done.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Players must be near each other | Off: players can trade from anywhere on the server. | On or off |
| Near means within (blocks) | How close two players must be to trade, while the setting before it is on. | 2 to 1000 |
| Only in the same world | Always on while players must be near each other. | On or off |

#### Coins

Players can put coins into a trade too (with any economy).

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Coins in trades | Off: items only. To switch /pay off, use the Coins tab: Players can pay each other. | On or off |
| Tax on traded coins (%) | Taken from the coins that change hands and removed from the economy. 0 = none. | 0 to 50 |

#### The trade

What keeps trades fair.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Item slots for each player | How many different stacks each player can put into one trade. | 1 to 18 |
| Countdown after both are ready (seconds) | Any change stops it, so nobody can swap an item at the last moment. | 1 to 10 |
| A request waits (seconds) | How long a /trade request stays open for the other player to accept. After that it is gone. | 10 to 600 |
| Before asking the same player again (seconds) | How long a player waits before sending the same player another request, so nobody can spam requests. 0: no wait. | 0 to 600 |
| Items that can never be traded | Item ids, with commas. End with * for every id that starts so: Crate_Key_* | Text |
| Log every trade | In the server log and /tempest log: who gave what to whom. | On or off |


# Slot machines

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Slot machines


**How to play**

- Walk up to a slot machine and press F. Each spin takes your bet from your wallet; line up three of the same symbol to win.

**Your bet**

- Crouch and press F on a machine, or type /slotbet, to choose your bet: 10, 50, 100 or 500 copper. Yours is 10 right now. Every prize below is your bet times the payout, so a bigger bet wins bigger.

**What three of a kind pay**

- Three cherries: 2 times your bet
- Three bells: 4 times your bet
- Three coins: 6 times your bet
- Three diamonds: 16 times your bet

**The jackpot**

- Three sevens win the jackpot: 10 times your bet plus the whole pot, which is 500 copper right now. Part of every lost spin goes into the pot, so it keeps growing until someone wins it.
- Bet 500 to win the whole pot. A smaller bet wins a share: 10 wins 2% of it.

**Your winnings**

- Winnings come out of the machine as coins. For 90 seconds only you can pick them up; after that, anyone can.

**Good to know**

- A machine takes one spin at a time. If someone else is spinning, wait for the reels to stop.
- The machines are a game of luck. Some spins win big, but over many spins they pay back less than you put in.
- Only admins can build slot machines on this server.


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/jackpot` | Everyone | Show the slot machine jackpot |
| `/slotbet` | Everyone | Choose how much each slot machine spin costs |
| `/slotstats` | `slotmachine.admin.stats` | Show slot machine totals and payback |
| `/slotstats reset` | `slotmachine.admin.stats` | Start the slot machine totals again from zero |
| `/slottheme` | `slotmachine.admin.theme` | Gives you a slot machine with the chosen theme |
| `/slottoken` | `slotmachine.admin.token` | Gives you a slot machine token |

# Lottery

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Lottery


**How it works**

- Buy tickets for 100 copper each. Every 30 minutes one ticket is drawn, and its owner wins the whole pot. The more tickets you have, the better your chance.

**This round**

- Pot: 0 copper
- Tickets sold: 0. Yours: 0
- Drawing in: 29 minutes

**Good to know**

- Your tickets are kept if the server restarts. If you are offline when you win, the coins still go to your wallet.

# Coinflip

## What players read in /guide

The `/guide` pages of this plugin, as a player sees them on a test server (numbers are examples).

### Coinflip


**How it works**

- Make a room: pick a stake and a side, heads or tails. Your stake is held while the room is open.
- Another player joins with the same stake on the other side. The coin flips, and the winner takes the pot.
- Stakes from 10 copper to 1,000,000 copper.
- A room nobody joins closes after 30 min and the stake comes back.
- If the server restarts, open rooms close and their stakes come back. A coin already in the air is paid out.

**Provably fair**

- Every room has a secret seed from the start. Its SHA-256 is shown while the room is open, so it cannot be changed later.
- After the flip the seed is shown. The roll is the first 13 hex digits of SHA-256(seed:room id) divided by 16^13; under 0.5 is heads.

**You**

- Won 1, lost 2. Profit: +850 copper (staked 2,150 copper in all).

**Admins also read:**

- Won 2, lost 1. Profit: -850 copper (staked 2,150 copper in all).


## Commands

| Command | Who can use it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/coinflip` (/cf) | Everyone | Open the coinflip rooms |
| `/coinflip cancel` | Everyone | Close your open rooms and get your stakes back |
| `/coinflip create` | Everyone | Open a room with a stake |
| `/coinflip join` | Everyone | Join a player's room |
| `/coinflip list` | Everyone | List the open rooms in chat |


## Settings

Every setting is changed in game with `/tempest` and saved at once; nothing needs a restart. Amounts of 0 are off unless the setting says otherwise.

### Coinflip

`/tempest` → Coinflip. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.coinflip`.

Players stake coins on heads or tails; another player matches the stake and the coin decides.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Coinflip is open | Off: no new rooms and no joining. Open rooms can still be cancelled. | On or off |

#### Stakes

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Smallest stake | The least a player can bet when they open or join a coinflip room. | 1 to 1000000000 |
| Largest stake | 0 = no limit. | 0 to 1000000000000 |
| Open rooms per player | How many rooms one player can have waiting for an opponent at the same time. | 1 to 20 |
| Rooms close after (minutes) | A room nobody joins closes and its stake goes back. 0 = never. | 0 to 1440 |
| House fee (%) | Kept from the pot; it leaves the game. | 0 to 50 |

#### The flip

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Flip time (seconds) | How long the coin spins; the winner is paid when it lands. | 1 to 10 |
| Show the flip to the room's maker | Opens the flip for them when someone joins, unless another page is open. | On or off |
| Sounds | On: ticks while the coin spins, and a win sound for the winner. | On or off |

#### Announcements

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tell everyone about new rooms | On: a chat line to everyone when a player opens a room, with the stake. At most one per player every 30 seconds, so chat cannot be flooded. | On or off |
| Tell everyone about flips from (pot) | Also sent to Discord. 0 = never. | 0 to 1000000000000 |
| Chat tag | Tag | Text |
| Colour | The colour of the coinflip's tag word in front of its chat messages. | A colour |


# Leveling mods for server owners

What the Tempest plugins do with Endless Leveling and MMO Skill Tree, alone or together, and where it is set.

Tempest works with **Endless Leveling** (by Airijko) and **MMO Skill Tree** (by Ziggfreed). Nothing of either mod
is shipped: Tempest Core finds them through their public APIs within half a minute of the server starting. Without
them, nothing changes, and no level requirement ever locks a player out because a mod is missing.

## One mod, or both

| Installed | What happens |
|---|---|
| Endless Leveling only | Its level counts for everything below; its prestige, dungeons, wave gates, raids, classes and mob levels work too |
| MMO Skill Tree only | Its skills become one level (total, combat, power level or the highest skill, as you choose); skill and achievement rewards work too |
| Both | You choose whose level counts ("Leveling mod" on the Leveling tab). Only that mod's level-ups pay level-up money, so nothing is paid twice. Endless Leveling's dungeons, gates and raids and MMO Skill Tree's skill and achievement rewards keep working. "Double leveling XP" raises both |

## Where to set it: `/tempest`

Every amount starts at 0, which is off: installing a mod changes nothing until you choose.

| Tab | Shown | What is on it |
|---|---|---|
| Leveling | With either mod | Which mod counts (with "In use: ..."), money per level-up and milestones, the level bonus on other rewards, chat lines, boards, XP boosts |
| Leveling extras | With either mod | Commands at levels, leveling XP from the economy (daily rewards, crates, contracts, the shop, town projects), levels for paying and gambling (stops alts), town bonuses |
| Endless Leveling | Only with Endless Leveling | Prestige (money, a command, a bonus), dungeon, gate and raid money, mob gold by mob level, elite mobs |
| MMO Skill Tree | Only with MMO Skill Tree | Which number is "the level", which skill gets Tempest's XP, money and items per skill level and at milestones, achievement and server-first rewards |
| Pass leveling, PvP leveling, Events leveling | With their plugin | Pass XP for level-ups (and Endless Leveling clears), PvP rewards by level, events that start with raids (Endless Leveling) |

## What players get

| Plugin | With a leveling mod |
|---|---|
| Core | Money for level-ups, commands and items at levels, a bonus on other rewards by level, placeholders and a "Highest levels" board |
| Quests | Goals: reach a level; with Endless Leveling also prestige, dungeons, gates, raids and strong mobs; with MMO Skill Tree reach a skill level, gain skill XP, earn achievements, finish its quests, talk to characters. Rewards can give leveling XP (a goal about one skill gives that skill's XP) |
| Shop, Crates, Quests | Items, crates and quests that need a level (and with Endless Leveling a class) |
| Pass | Pass XP for level-ups; tiers can give leveling XP |
| Jobs | Job work gives leveling XP; a job can need a level |
| Contracts | PvP rewards for underdogs and fines for bullies, by level |
| Events | "Double leveling XP" events; with Endless Leveling community goals for dungeons, gates and raids |

## MMO Skill Tree rewards

| Reward | How it works |
|---|---|
| Money per skill level | Paid for every level gained in a skill, more at higher levels; only above the highest level ever paid, so a reset pays nothing again |
| Skill milestones | A bonus, items (what does not fit goes to `/mail`) and a line for everyone every so many levels |
| Only these skills | Limit the rewards to the skills you list |
| Achievements | Money per achievement and per achievement point, once each |
| Server firsts | A bonus, items and a line for everyone for an achievement only the first player can earn |

Placeholders: `{leveling_level}` (the level that counts), `{mmo_total_level}`, `{mmo_combat_level}`, `{mmo_power}`.

> **Note:** MMO Skill Tree reads a player when they join, every half minute and after every XP gain. A player who has
> just joined may show no level for a moment.

## Every leveling setting

The tabs as a server with both Endless Leveling and MMO Skill Tree shows them; with one mod, only its tabs and the shared ones appear.

### Leveling

`/tempest` → Leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

#### How leveling works

Tempest reads each player's level from a leveling mod and can pay for it: money for level-ups, commands and items at levels, a bonus on other rewards. Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling and MMO Skill Tree all work, alone or together, and so does any mod that links itself to Tempest. What only one of them has is on its own tab, shown only while it is installed. With several installed, "Leveling mod" picks whose level counts for level-up money, "needs level", the Pass and the board. Every amount starts at 0, which is off.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Leveling mod | Whose level counts. Automatic: a linked mod, else Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree | Automatic, Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling, MMO Skill Tree |

#### Money for level-ups

Paid each time a player's level goes up. Example: 50 a level, 2 more for each level reached and 500 every 10 levels: going from level 9 to 10 pays 570 (50 + 20 + 500).

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Money per level-up | Paid for every level a player gains; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| More for each level reached | Level 30 pays 30 times this on top, so higher levels pay more; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Milestone every | A bonus at levels 10, 20, 30... with 10; 0 is off | 0 to 10000 |
| Milestone bonus | Paid on top at each milestone level | 0 to 1000000000 |

#### Level bonus on other rewards

A higher level raises the rewards ticked below, as rank perks do. Example: 2% for every 10 levels makes a level 40 player earn 8% more.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Bonus per 10 levels (%) | 0 is off | 0 to 1000 |
| Highest bonus (%) | Never more than this, prestige bonus included | 0 to 1000 |
| Raises mob gold | On: the level bonus also raises the coins mobs drop (Tempest Economy). | On or off |
| Raises quest rewards | On: the level bonus also raises the money from quests and achievements (Tempest Quests). | On or off |
| Raises daily rewards | On: the level bonus also raises daily rewards. | On or off |
| Raises battle pass XP | On: the level bonus also raises the XP players get for the battle pass (Tempest Pass). | On or off |
| Raises what the shop pays | Never above the shop's own buying price | On or off |

#### Chat, boards and XP boosts

What players see, and the "double leveling XP" of Tempest Events, rank perks and boosters (with both mods installed it raises both mods' XP).

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tell players what they got | A chat line with the money for each level-up, skill level or clear | On or off |
| Leveling leaderboards | Highest levels; with Endless Leveling also prestige, dungeons, gates | On or off |
| Leveling XP boosts | Off: events, perks and boosters never add leveling XP | On or off |
| Highest Leveling XP boost (%) | All boosts together never give more than this: 100 is double XP | 0 to 1000 |


### Leveling extras

`/tempest` → Leveling extras. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

More rewards for levels, with any leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling or MMO Skill Tree). Money for level-ups is on the Leveling tab.

#### Commands at levels

Run by the server console when a player reaches a level: ranks, kits, titles from other plugins. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. Example: level 25, rank give {player} adept. Level 0 turns a reward off. Only a full admin (tempest.admin) can change the commands.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Reward 1 at level | The level at which the command below runs. 0: this reward is off. | 0 to 100000 |
| Reward 1 command | Run by the server console when a player reaches the level above, such as: rank give {player} adept. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. | Text |
| Reward 2 at level | The level at which the command below runs. 0: this reward is off. | 0 to 100000 |
| Reward 2 command | Run by the server console when a player reaches the level above, such as: rank give {player} adept. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. | Text |
| Reward 3 at level | The level at which the command below runs. 0: this reward is off. | 0 to 100000 |
| Reward 3 command | Run by the server console when a player reaches the level above, such as: rank give {player} adept. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. | Text |
| Reward 4 at level | The level at which the command below runs. 0: this reward is off. | 0 to 100000 |
| Reward 4 command | Run by the server console when a player reaches the level above, such as: rank give {player} adept. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. | Text |
| Reward 5 at level | The level at which the command below runs. 0: this reward is off. | 0 to 100000 |
| Reward 5 command | Run by the server console when a player reaches the level above, such as: rank give {player} adept. {player}, {uuid} and {level} are filled in. | Text |

#### Leveling XP from the economy

Leveling XP for what players do in the Tempest plugins, with the leveling mod's own bonuses. With MMO Skill Tree it goes into the skill chosen on its tab. 0 turns one off.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| XP per daily reward | Leveling XP each time a player claims their daily reward. | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per crate opened | Leveling XP for each crate a player opens. | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per contract delivery | Leveling XP for each delivery to a contract or a server order (Tempest Contracts), however many items it holds. | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per 100 the shop pays | Selling 500 worth at 2 gives 10 XP | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per item given to a town project | Tempest Projects: building the town levels you up | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per 100 coins given to a project | Leveling XP for every 100 coins a player gives to a town project (Tempest Projects). 250 coins at 2 gives 5 XP. | 0 to 1000000 |

#### Stopping alts

New characters made only to feed money to a main cannot pay or gamble until they reach a level.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Pay other players from level | 0 is off | 0 to 100000 |
| Games of chance from level | Slots, lottery and coinflip; 0 is off | 0 to 100000 |

#### Mob gold by mob level

Tempest Economy's mob gold grows with the mob's level, with a leveling mod that gives mobs levels (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling). Stronger mobs already have more health and gold follows health, so start low. Nothing changes with a mod without mob levels.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| More gold per mob level (%) | A level 20 mob at 5% drops double; 0 is off | 0 to 1000 |
| Most extra gold (%) | However high the mob's level | 0 to 10000 |
| No gold from mobs this far below | Levels below the killer: stops farming weak mobs; 0 is off | 0 to 10000 |

#### Elite mobs

Mobs from a level on are elite: more gold, and the server hears who defeated one.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Elite from mob level | 0 is off | 0 to 100000 |
| Elite gold bonus (%) | On top of the gold per mob level | 0 to 10000 |
| Tell everyone about elite kills | On: when a player defeats an elite mob, the whole server reads a line such as "Steve defeated an elite level 60 Trork Warlord!". Nothing happens while "Elite from mob level" is 0. | On or off |

#### Town bonuses

With Tempest Town: these work only once a town unlock gives them (its editor, Features). Every other leveling feature can be made to wait for an unlock too.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Town XP bonus (%) | More leveling XP for everyone, e.g. once Training Grounds are built | 0 to 1000 |
| Town clear money bonus (%) | More money for Endless Leveling dungeon, gate and raid clears | 0 to 10000 |
| Town mob gold bonus (%) | More gold from every mob | 0 to 1000 |


### Endless Leveling

`/tempest` → Endless Leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

What only Endless Leveling has. This tab shows only while it is installed (also next to MMO Skill Tree); level-up money and everything else about levels is on the Leveling tab. Every amount starts at 0, which is off.

#### Prestige

Rewards each time a player prestiges. Paid while Endless Leveling gives the level (the Leveling tab's choice).

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Money per prestige | 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Command at each prestige | Run by the console; {player}, {uuid}, {prestige} filled in; empty is off Run by the server console each time a player prestiges, such as: rank give {player} veteran. Only a full admin (tempest.admin) can change it, as it runs with every power. | Text |
| Bonus per prestige (%) | 10 makes prestige 3 earn 30% more (rewards ticked on Leveling); 0 is off | 0 to 1000 |

#### Dungeons, gates and raids

Paid when Endless Leveling announces a clear, to every player who was in it. Example: 100 a dungeon and a 20% rank bonus pay 200 for an S rank dungeon.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Money per dungeon clear | Paid to every player in a dungeon when it is cleared; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Money per wave gate clear | Paid to everyone who fought in a cleared wave gate; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Gate money per wave | On top, for every wave the gate lasted | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Fewest waves for gate money | A gate given up sooner pays nothing; 0 pays every gate | 0 to 1000 |
| Rank bonus (%) | More for each rank above E, for dungeons and gates: 20 makes S pay double | 0 to 1000 |
| Money per raid clear | Paid to a player who finishes a raid; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Raid money per wave | On top, for every raid wave finished | 0 to 1000000000 |


### MMO Skill Tree

`/tempest` → MMO Skill Tree. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.core`.

What only MMO Skill Tree has: its skills and achievements. This tab shows only while it is installed (also next to Endless Leveling); level-up money and everything else about levels is on the Leveling tab. Every amount starts at 0, which is off.

#### One level from many skills

Tempest needs one level per player (for level-up money, "needs level", the Pass, the level board). Choose which of MMO Skill Tree's numbers that is. Used while MMO Skill Tree gives the level (the Leveling tab's "Leveling mod").

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| The level is | Total, combat or power level (1-200) | Total level, Combat level, Power level (1-200), Highest skill |
| Leveling XP goes to | Gets XP from quests, crates and the Pass | Last skill used |

#### Skill levels

Money for each level of a skill. Example: 20 a level, 1 more for each level reached and 300 every 10 levels: Mining 9 to 10 pays 330 (20 + 10 + 300). A skill pays only above the highest level ever paid for it: a reset pays nothing again.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Money per skill level | Paid for every level gained in any skill; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| More for each level reached | Mining 30 pays 30 times this on top, so higher levels pay more; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Skill milestone every | Levels 10, 20, 30... with 10; 0 is no milestones | 0 to 10000 |
| Milestone bonus | Paid on top at each milestone | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Milestone items | e.g. Ingredient_Bar_Iron x16, Food_Bread x5; what does not fit goes to /mail | Text |
| Tell everyone at milestones | "Steve reached Mining level 50!" for the whole server | On or off |
| Only these skills | Skills that pay, by id or name, with commas (Mining, Swords); blank is every skill | Text |

#### Achievements

Money when a player earns an MMO Skill Tree achievement, once per achievement. Server firsts (achievements only the first player can earn) can pay more.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Money per achievement | 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Money per achievement point | Times the achievement's points: harder achievements pay more; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Server first bonus | On top, for a server first; 0 is off | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Server first items | Given for a server first, e.g. Ingredient_Bar_Gold x10 | Text |
| Tell everyone about server firsts | "Steve is the first on the server to earn Dragon Slayer!" | On or off |


### Pass leveling

`/tempest` → Pass leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.pass`.

#### Pass XP from leveling

Battle pass XP for what players do in the server's leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling or MMO Skill Tree; dungeons, gates and raids only with Endless Leveling). 0 turns one off.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| XP per level-up | For every level a player gains, in the mod chosen on Core's Leveling tab | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per prestige | Endless Leveling only | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per dungeon clear | Endless Leveling only: to every player in the dungeon | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per wave gate clear | Endless Leveling only: to everyone who fought in the gate | 0 to 1000000 |
| XP per raid clear | Endless Leveling only | 0 to 1000000 |
| Most of this XP a day | All of the above together, per player; 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000 |


### Jobs leveling

`/tempest` → Jobs leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.jobsleveling`.

#### Jobs with a leveling mod

Work gives leveling XP too (Endless Leveling, or MMO Skill Tree in the skill chosen on its tab); with Endless Leveling, stronger mobs also pay hunters more.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Leveling XP per job XP | 0.5 gives 5 leveling XP for 10 job XP; 0 is off | 0 to 1000 |
| Hunter pay per mob level (%) | Endless Leveling only: a level 20 mob at 2% pays 40% more; 0 is off | 0 to 100 |


### PvP leveling

`/tempest` → PvP leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.pvpleveling`.

#### PvP with levels

Levels from the server's leveling mod (Endless Leveling, RPG Leveling or MMO Skill Tree) decide what a PvP kill is worth. Everything here is off at 0.

#### Bounties

Who may claim a bounty.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Bounty level gap | A hunter this many levels above the target cannot claim it: no bounty farming on new players | 0 to 10000 |
| No bounties between party members | Endless Leveling parties: friends cannot claim bounties on each other | On or off |

#### Underdog reward

The server pays a player who defeats someone of a higher level. Party members never count.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Reward per level above | For each level the defeated player was higher | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Lowest level gap | Fewer levels between them pay nothing | 0 to 10000 |
| Most for one kill | 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Hours before the same pair pays again | Stops two players trading kills for money | 0 to 720 |
| Most a player gets a day | All underdog rewards together; 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000000 |

#### Bully fine

A player who defeats someone far below their level pays them. The money moves from the killer to the victim, never made.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Fine per level below | For each level the victim was lower | 0 to 1000000000 |
| Lowest level gap for a fine | The killer pays only when the victim was at least this many levels lower. 10: a level 30 player who kills a level 20 pays; one who kills a level 25 does not. The fine counts every level of the gap. | 0 to 10000 |
| Highest fine | Never more than the killer has; 0 is no limit | 0 to 1000000000 |


### Events leveling

`/tempest` → Events leveling. Who can change it: `tempest.admin` or `tempest.admin.eventsleveling`.

#### Events with Endless Leveling

Only with Endless Leveling: community goals for dungeons, wave gates and raids are in each event's editor (/events, Manage). Here: an event that starts by itself with every raid.

| Setting | What it does | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Start an event when a raid starts | Only when no other event is on. Events must be switched on. | On or off |
| Event it starts | The event that starts by itself when an Endless Leveling raid starts. Make and change events in /events, Manage. | Gold Rush, Monster Hunt, XP Frenzy, Market Day, Lucky Hour |
| For how long (minutes) | 0: the event's own length | 0 to 10080 |


# Quick start

From an empty plugin to one that pays players and reads their level, in five steps.

## Checklist

| Step | What to do |
|---|---|
| 1 | Put Tempest Core (and the plugins you use) in your server's `mods` folder, and compile against their jars with `compileOnly` |
| 2 | Depend on `AtomicTempest:Core` in your `manifest.json`; make the other Tempest plugins optional |
| 3 | Make one `Registrations` for your plugin and `close()` it in `shutdown()` |
| 4 | Ask Core for what you need on every use (`Economies.get()`, `Levels.get()`): mods can start after yours |
| 5 | Before using anything newer than the Core you support, check `CoreAPI.runningVersion()` |

## 1. Compile against the jars

Download the jars from the plugins' CurseForge pages, then in `build.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencies {
    compileOnly(files("libs/Core-1.5.0.jar"))
    compileOnly(files("libs/Quests-1.4.0.jar"))   // only if you use it
}
```

`compileOnly` means the jars are not packed into yours: the server loads them from its `mods` folder.

## 2. Declare the dependencies

```json
"Dependencies": { "AtomicTempest:Core": "*" },
"OptionalDependencies": { "AtomicTempest:Coins": "*", "AtomicTempest:Quests": "*" }
```

> **Note:** With an optional dependency, check that the plugin is there (`QuestsAPI.isAvailable()`,
> `CoinsAPI.get() != null`) and touch its classes in one class of yours only, so your plugin still loads without it.

## 3. Register with Core

```java
public class DragonsPlugin extends JavaPlugin {
    private final Registrations core = new Registrations("Dragons");

    public DragonsPlugin(JavaPluginInit init) {
        super(init);
    }

    @Override
    protected void setup() {
        core.placeholder("dragons_slain", uuid -> String.valueOf(slain(uuid)));
        core.onAction((player, action, amount) -> {
            if (action.equals(PlayerActions.CRATE_OPEN)) { /* a crate was opened */ }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void shutdown() {
        core.close();   // takes back everything registered above
        super.shutdown();
    }
}
```
